a Crash Course on the Vehicles of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e","headline":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGet a Crash Course on the Vehicles of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eHibi shares the basics so you’re ready to climb into the cockpit.\u003c/span\u003e","summary":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHibi shares the basics so you’re ready to climb into the cockpit.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBehind every winning racer is a phenomenal mechanic, and Shade and Hibi are no exception! The mysterious and masked Shade, the protagonist of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-galactic-racer\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, can always count on the Ardennian engineer to lend a hand – or four.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHibi has been taking the time to explain the vehicles Shade will be racing in the Galactic League in her very own video series, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eUnder the Hood\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. In the latest and last installment, the excitable mechanic gives us the ins and outs of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/podracer\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003epodracers\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e! Get your first look at the video below, along with the other repulsorcraft you'll be piloting when \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e comes out on October 6.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eStart your engines!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/bRZlrmyOflw\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePodracer\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNow this is... well, you know.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePodracers are built for speed and customized to their pilots. Energy binder arcs spark and crackle as the repulsorcraft powers up. The engines can come in all shapes and sizes, but they all roar to life as the race begins. Only one pilot can sit in the cockpit, and they need lightning-fast reflexes just to stay on track and finish the race.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, podracers are outfitted with ramjets to reach even more dizzying speeds. Tight turns are taken with the help of the airbrake, but the vehicle's velocity drops dramatically. Find the right equilibrium to win the race.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/WhcTNAXcaeY\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSkim Speeders\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe graceful skim speeder makes its debut in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e! While its original purpose may have been smuggling, Galactic League founder Darius Pax introduced the skim speeder to the racing scene and it fit right in. Like all repulsorcraft, skim speeders make use of repulsorlift generators to nullify the force of gravity, paired with turbine thrusters and fuel for high-powered propulsion.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe perfect balance of resilience and agility, skim speeders can take sharp corners with their unique Knife Edge maneuver. Racers who adapt to the skim speeder's slow acceleration are a force to be reckoned with on the racetrack. Ramjets and afterburners, timed just right, can make the difference for Shade to come out on top.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/ablxJTSJZAo\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSpeeder Bikes\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSacrificing unnecessary systems for velocity and agility, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/speeder-bike\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003espeeder bikes\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e careen through racetracks at a breakneck speed. Some models use footpad controls for speed and altitude, and all are equipped with shoulder-level handgrips that regulate elevation and direction. It's a popular vehicle across the galaxy with diverse uses ranging from children's hoverbikes to Imperial combat speeders.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGalactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a Kinetic Burst temporarily boosts the speeder bike's speed even faster, but at a cost of control and wide turns under unpracticed hands. The lightweight repulsorcraft offers very little in terms of armor, making it even easier to crash spectacularly on the track, but many pilots feel the trade-off is worth it.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/IyE4NdiEDAk\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLandspeeders\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHit the accelerator! \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/landspeeder\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLandspeeders\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are used on planets across the galaxy as personal transports and cargo carriers. The ones in the Galactic League are customized with competitive racing in mind. They offer surprising speed and maneuverability, along with a myriad of options for customization for getting the job done.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs one of the beefier repulsorcraft, the landspeeder's excellent handling makes it an ideal vehicle for getting started in the League. It's made for stability and drifting through corners. While not built for speed, a well-timed ramjet boost can shave off some seconds in a pinch. It's also durable compared to the other vehicles, able to withstand the jolt from another racer looking to score a cheap hit.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFind the vehicle that fits your racing style when \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Galactic Racer\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e blasts off on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://starwarsgalacticracer.com/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on October 6\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"September 29, 2026","publish_date_short":"Sep Team-Ups\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eThe Chosen One, who will return in\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Ahsoka \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSeason 2 and appears in the recently-released \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSeason 2 and appears in the recently-released \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ehas joined forces with many notable heroes and villains.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe term “Zero Company” definitely doesn’t apply to the Chosen One in the galaxy far, far away. Throughout his most dangerous missions and scariest moments, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e has had no shortage of allies, standing side by side, saber or blaster in hand.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs we join in on Anakin’s latest alliance as he makes a cameo in the Clone Wars-era video game \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-zero-company\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and we get ready for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/ahsoka-season-2\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAhsoka\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Season 2, we present some of our favorite Anakin team-ups — before that business on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/mustafar\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMustafar\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/anakin-skywalker-team-up-the-clone-wars-padme_85b5a1ae.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"Anakin and Padme in the Season 1 finale of Star Wars: The Clone Wars (“Hostage Crisis”).\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePadmé Amidala\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin’s secret love has been known to team up with him in battle, even though \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/padme-amidala\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePadmé\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e preferred words of diplomacy over weapons. Sometimes, you’re chained to a pole in a Geonosis arena waiting to become lunch meat for a pack of fearsome creatures. Then, you fight. And Padmé certainly knew how to fight.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnother memorable moment of peril for the loving couple was in the Season 1 finale of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/clone-wars/hostage-crisis-episode-guide\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003e(“Hostage Crisis”)\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Anakin playfully presents Padmé with his lightsaber in a show of devotion and love just before Cad Bane and his cronies drop by Coruscant in an effort to free Ziro the Hutt. Padmé is captured, and the now saber-less Anakin is also apprehended. Hasn’t he heard that a Jedi’s lightsaber is their life? When he wakes up, Anakin finds himself among the hostages and surrounded by laser-triggered bombs. Luckily, Padmé finds a clever way to return Anakin’s lightsaber and he saves the day just before the bombs detonate.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhat makes Anakin and Padmé team-ups fun are the hidden layers of their relationship, a secret the fans are always in on. It was always interesting to me to see how Anakin’s urgency and motivations were amplified when Padmé was involved in a mission. And how could they not — there is arguably no more important figure in Anakin’s life than Padmé!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/26Dk0Tfb7_s\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eObi-Wan Kenobi\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eI’ve read \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e5-Minute Star Wars Stories\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e to my two young daughters countless times, cover to cover, and the tale they request the most is “The Last Adventure.” In the retelling of the infamous mission to save Supreme Chancellor Palpatine at the start of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sith\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Revenge of the Sith\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the duo of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/obi-wan-kenobi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eObi-Wan Kenobi\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Anakin Skywalker are described as “the perfect team.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGiven their several years as Master and apprentice, Obi-Wan and Anakin have no shortage of team-ups to choose from. My personal favorite is the five-part Marvel comics miniseries \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eObi-Wan and Anakin\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e written by Charles Soule. Released in 2016, the series dives into the trials and tribulations of the Master and apprentice dynamic and the growing pains that both Jedi face.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBut it’s hard to top the excitement of their daring rescue in Episode III, with all the high-speed chases, slashing lightsabers, and levity that give \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e its action and heart. As the final line of “The Last Adventure” reads, “Obi-Wan was sure there was already another mission waiting for them. But he also knew that, together, he and Anakin would be ready for anything.” (Insert sad Grogu gif here.)\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/the-making-of-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-rotta-the-hutt-_4db31dc1.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,541\" alt=\"Rotta the Huttlett riding around in Ahsoka Tano’s backpack.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhsoka Tano\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eStarting with the exchange in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e animated movie that resulted in Anakin’s nickname of Skyguy, Anakin and his Padawan \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ahsoka-tano\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhsoka Tano\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e (AKA Snips) have become one of the most iconic pairings in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. (A rewatch of the latest \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-ahsoka\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAhsoka\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Season 2 trailer supports our theory!) Whether it’s heading to Teth to rescue Rotta the Huttlet, freeing slaves on Zygerria, or any of the countless other battlefronts and planets they visited during the Clone Wars, Skyguy and Snips vanquished many foes as a team, all while playfully slinging verbal jabs at each other.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv mh-tiktok-node-alignment=\"center\" mh-tiktok-node-src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7278063247159233835\" class=\"mh-tiktok\" style=\"justify-content: center; display: flex;\"\u003e\n\u003cblockquote class=\"tiktok-embed\" data-video-id=\"7278063247159233835\" data-embed-from=\"oembed\" cite=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7278063247159233835\" style=\"margin: 0px; padding: 0px; max-width: 325px;\"\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7278063247159233835\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/blockquote\u003e\n\u003cscript src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/embed.js\" id=\"mh-social-widget-script\" async=\"\"\u003e\u003c/script\u003e\n\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChoosing a single favorite Ahsoka/Anakin team-up is a matter of personal preference. I loved Anakin’s surprise return in Season 1 of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAhsoka\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/world-between-worlds\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWorld Between Worlds\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The unexpected reunion felt like a beautiful love letter to their entire relationship — complete with a patented Anakin spin behind his back during a lightsaber duel. His “Hello, Snips….” still gives me chills, as well as the brilliant live-action interpretation of some of their pivotal animated moments on the battlefront.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/P5yHvulpTCQ\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eQui-Gon Jinn\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eObi-Wan’s Master and his apprentice never fought in a war together, but they did team up on one very important battlefield: the podracing track. In \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-i-the-phantom-menace\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Phantom Menace\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/qui-gon-jinn\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eQui-Gon\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e went from Jedi Master to coach, and all because Watto didn’t accept Republic credits. Qui-Gon fills young Ani with confidence and determination before he puts on his helmet (and cute goggles) and nervously, but with youthful passion, heads to the starting line of the Boonta Eve Classic.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin would go on to defy all the odds and win the big race, sending ol’ Sebulba into a spiral, which he no doubt is still feeling. Qui-Gon believed Anakin was the Chosen One, and this battle – from a certain point of view, anyway – was among Anakin’s most important and formative.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 69%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/anakin-skywalker-team-up-star-wars-thrawn-alliances-cov_4a2d6378.jpeg?region=0,0,709,1080\" alt=\"Thrawn: Alliances by Timothy Zahn cover\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThrawn\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Chiss and the Chosen One had one team-up, but it was memorable, and my personal favorite!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn the novel \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThrawn: Alliances\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e by Timothy Zahn, the future Grand Admiral and soon-to-be Sith Lord join forces to serve mutual benefits. Anakin wants to find and save Padmé from Batuu; \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grand-admiral-thrawn\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThrawn\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e wants to learn more about the Clone Wars. This chance encounter would be remembered by Thrawn years later when Palpatine sends him and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e on a mission to Batuu. Showing off his cunning skill, Thrawn is one of the few to put the pieces together that Vader is in fact Anakin. While he doesn’t outright confront Vader with that knowledge – Thrawn, the master tactician, knows better than that – he leaves hints, both confusing and annoying Vader in the process. Seeing Thrawn carefully choose his words in an attempt to lead Vader just far enough along to give him pause makes for a buddy cop vibe that is, for me, perfect. That Thrawn is relishing it makes it even funnier.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"September 24, 2026","publish_date_short":"Sep More","images":{"thumb_images":{"thumb_baseball_card":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=115%2C0%2C770%2C1000","thumb_4x3":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=1%2C0%2C999%2C749","thumb_1x1":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=0%2C0%2C1000%2C1000","thumb_2x3":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=167%2C0%2C666%2C1000"}},"thumb_images":{"thumb_baseball_card":{"src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=115,0,770,1000","base_src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg","width":770,"height":1000,"aspect_ratio":1.2987,"aspect_ratio_pct":"129.87%","orientation":"portrait","half_width":385,"half_height":500},"thumb_4x3":{"src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=1,0,999,749","base_src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg","width":999,"height":749,"aspect_ratio":0.7497,"aspect_ratio_pct":"74.97%","orientation":"landscape","half_width":500,"half_height":375},"thumb_1x1":{"src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=0,0,1000,1000","base_src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg","width":1000,"height":1000,"aspect_ratio":1.0,"aspect_ratio_pct":"100.0%","orientation":"landscape","half_width":500,"half_height":500},"thumb_2x3":{"src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=167,0,666,1000","base_src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg","width":666,"height":1000,"aspect_ratio":1.5015,"aspect_ratio_pct":"150.15%","orientation":"portrait","half_width":333,"half_height":500}},"thumb_data":{"src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg?region=115,0,770,1000","base_src":"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/author_wainerdi_8256f92f.jpeg","width":770,"height":1000,"aspect_ratio":1.2987,"aspect_ratio_pct":"129.87%","orientation":"portrait","half_width":385,"half_height":500},"alt_text":"Brandon Wainerdi","section_label":"articleauthor","section_class":"articleauthor","type":"ArticleAuthor","href":"https://www.starwars.com/news/contributor/bwainerdi"}],"primary_category":null,"author_by_line":"","company":null,"text_content":{"headline_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eHistory of the Hutts\u003c/span\u003e","headline":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHistory of the Hutts\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eEverything you need to know about their slimy history. Or should we say Huttstory?\u003c/span\u003e","summary":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEverything you need to know about their slimy history. Or should we say Huttstory?\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNow that you've met \u003c/span\u003e\u003cs\u003e\u003cspan\u003eStinky\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/s\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rotta-the-hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRotta the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, (and survived the wiles of the conniving Hutt \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-twins\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTwins\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e), you may be wondering: what exactly are Hutts? And why are they so important to the larger galaxy?\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn our real world, the first slug to show up on screen was perhaps the most famous member of this alien race: \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jabba-the-hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJabba the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Initially only mentioned in the original 1977 cut of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Jabba remained rather elusive for almost six years.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/hutt-history-sw-behind-the0scenes-declan-mulholland_2ed3c9cd.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1297\" alt=\"Declan Mulholland on set of Star Wars (1977) as Jabba the Hutt.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003cfigcaption style=\" text-align: center;\"\u003eDeclan Mulholland on set of Star Wars (1977) as Jabba the Hutt. \u003c/figcaption\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBehind the (Max Rebo Band) Music\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJabba was actually first portrayed by Irish actor Declan Mulholland (wearing a fabulous fur coat) in the Docking Bay 94 showdown with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/han-solo\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHan Solo\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. But this \"Human Jabba\" scene cut from the first \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e film and Jabba's appearance remained a mystery for many years. In fact, Jabba was shown as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.marvel.com/articles/comics/star-wars-the-unexpected-story-of-the-wrong-jabba-the-hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ean entirely different alien race\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e — yellow, bearded, and humanoid — in the second issue of the Marvel Comics' adaptation of the original film. This \"Jabba\" made a couple of appearances in the comic series, all the way until \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Empire Strikes Back\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e premiered in 1980.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBut in 1983, that all changed and \"Huttstory\" was made. Jabba slithered onto the screen in his full glory. The film found him reigning as Daimyo from his towering palace on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tatooine\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTatooine\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and proud of his newest wall decoration — a frozen Han Solo in carbonite. Jabba's slug-like appearance (in real life an incredibly intricate puppet controlled by three puppeteers inside) kickstarted a whole host of tales — and tails — surrounding the rest of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hutt-clan\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHutt Clan\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/hutt-history-skeleton-crew_94d9fbeb.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,791\" alt=\"A Hutt seen at the Lanupa spa.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWorm-ridden filth\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs a species, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHutts\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are proud, slug-like, merciless, and rather enormous, with a slimy, swinging tail and three lungs. They can seemingly live for centuries (although, spoiler alert for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Return of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: Jabba dies prematurely at the ripe age of 604 at the hands of a Huttslayer). They usually speak Huttese, as is their cultural preference, and has been adopted as a very popular, near-universal language across the galaxy. They can also converse in Basic if required.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/nal-hutta-main_bba68429.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Nal Hutta\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile their ancestral planet is actually Varl, many consider \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/nal-hutta\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNal Hutta\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e as their true home — the boggy, swamp-like world where many of the Hutts reside. The temperature and humidity of Nal Hutta makes them comfortable, and they have built enormous structures and palaces across its surface. It is from this world that the Hutt Grand Council reaches its stubby little fingers across the galaxy, especially to the Outer Rim.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThis Council is a powerful group of elder Hutts who advise on all strategic decisions, as well as mediating family feuds. They represent the five Hutt families and have been in operation for untold centuries, controlling illicit trade across the galaxy.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/hutt-history-jabba-the-hutt-tcw-feature-rotta-the-hutt_37b4982b.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,806\" alt=\"Jabba the Hutt holding Rotta the Huttlet in The Clone Wars feature.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\"The Hutts are gangsters.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMajor players as far back as the dawn of the Republic, the Hutts managed to control their power and grow their reach across the Outer Rim for many years. By the time of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eClone Wars\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the Hutt Grand Council had become an enormous presence in galactic affairs. In fact, Jabba the Hutt was so powerful near the beginning of the Clone Wars that both the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/galactic-republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRepublic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/confederacy-of-independent-systems\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eConfederacy of Independent Systems\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e attempted to curry his favor. When his tiny son Rotta (yes, the very same) was kidnapped, it kicked off a galaxy-wide search, including an early official mission for Jedi \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and his young Padawan \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ahsoka-tano\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhsoka Tano\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Ultimately, it was revealed that \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/count-dooku\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCount Dooku\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and the Separatists were behind the kidnapping — alongside Jabba's uncle, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ziro-the-hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZiro\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. For a moment, Jabba aligned himself with the Republic, and Ziro was taken into Republic custody.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBut especially conniving (even by Hutt standards), Ziro had kept a secret diary of Hutt Council records, which contained their every dirty deed. The bounty hunter \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/cad-bane\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCad Bane\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e broke Ziro out of Republic custody and delivered him to the Hutt Council. Alongside his former lover and accomplice, the singer \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/sy-snootles\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSy Snootles\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Ziro was able to slither to safety. But it was that love that was the death of Ziro, as he was blinded by his feelings for Snooty, who betrayed and killed him. Afterward, she delivered the Hutt Council secrets to her true benefactor: Jabba.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/vbCIE-E_qkw\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA Wonderful Human Being\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs perhaps the most infamous member of his entire species, Jabba the Hutt (or \"Jabba Desilijic Tiure\" if you're being formal) was the leader of the Hutt Cartel for many years, most notably during both the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War. From Tatooine, he controlled much of the galaxy's most nefarious trade routes, as well as hiring many of the best smugglers and bounty hunters to bolster his criminal empire.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-rotj-quotes-jabba-decoration_38331c22.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,535\" alt=\"“I will not give up my favorite decoration.” - Jabba\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOne of these smugglers, a young Corellian named Han Solo, failed a job for the Hutt — dumping an expensive spice shipment when boarded by an Imperial patrol. This, of course, angered Jabba, who then put a bounty on Solo's head. Solo was frozen in carbonite and delivered to the Daimyo by the bounty hunter \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/boba-fett\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBoba Fett\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e thanks to a deal with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/galactic-empire\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEmpire\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, serving as a grimacing wall decoration until Solo was rescued by his friends.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJabba's laser-focused revenge proved to be his downfall. As a result of the undercover rebel mission to rescue Solo, Jabba the Hutt was ultimately killed at the hands (and chain) of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/leia-organa\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePrincess Leia Organa\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/alderaan\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAlderaan\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and his luxury sail barge was destroyed — an explosion over the Great Pit of Carkoon that killed several members of his sinister menagerie as well.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/the-twins-main_b11c7efb.jpeg?region=0,121,1920,1064\" alt=\"The Twins\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Mandalorian and Grogu and the Twins\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThere was now a significant power vacuum amongst the scum and villainy of the galaxy. And \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-twins\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Twins\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e were rather eager to fill it. Two cousins of Jabba, this brother and sister duo were always together, seemingly intertwined.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/So2mQE7KH3I\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAssuming the Hutt throne to be their birthright, they were nevertheless run off Tatooine by the bounty hunter Boba Fett — now the new Daimyo of the planet. And so, desperate to solidify their place in the galaxy, they began a hunt for the true heir to Jabba's seat of power — his son Rotta, who was now grown and competing as a gladiator. To accomplish this mission, they contracted \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-mandalorian\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDin Djarin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the famed Mandalorian, who tracked the Hutt Prince to the moon of Shakari. And that's where we meet them in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e…\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTails of the Underworld\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image media-image-inline\" style=\"margin-left: 1rem; float: right; max-width: 50%;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/hutt-history-star-wars-_09-grakkus_53b4818c.jpeg?region=0,0,702,1080\" alt=\"Grakkus in Marvel's Star Wars 9.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFor even more Hutt lore (or for new fans of buff Hutts), explore \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e comics, where you'll be rather pleased to meet Grakkus the Hutt. First appearing in Marvel's \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e (2015) Marvel comic run, Grakkus is a muscular gangster who gets around quickly on an insect-like bed of a dozen cybernetic legs. A collector of antiquities (especially those related to the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jedi-order\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJedi Order\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e), Grakkus discovered his ultimate collectible: the Jedi, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/luke-skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLuke Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Or, if you're trying to get up-close-and-personal, Grakkus has also appeared in the VR mixed reality playset game \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-beyond-victory-a-mixed-reality-playset\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Beyond Victory\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnother comics-specific storyline, the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eWar of the Bounty Hunters\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e traces the journey of a frozen Han Solo in carbonite to his eventual wall decoration status in the palace of Jabba the Hutt. Of course, the Hutt Council is a major player in this \"war\" and they find themselves in the crosshairs of Darth Vader. We won't spoil what happens there.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOne of Jabba's closest associates (and fellow fan of podracing), \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/gardulla-the-hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGardulla the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is known for buying Anakin and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/shmi-skywalker-lars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eShmi Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e when they first arrived on Tatooine. She lost them to the Toydarian \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/watto\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWatto\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, but you could still find her lurking in the shadows at the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/boonta-eve-classic-podracer-pilots\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBoonta Eve Classic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. And you can discover her fate in the recent comic series \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eLegacy of Vader\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, where she encounters Anakin's grandson — a fuming \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/kylo-ren\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKylo Ren\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIf there are credits to be made, you can be sure that the Hutts will always have a place in this galaxy far, far away. They're some of the most mysterious, conniving and impossible-to-overlook creatures in the entire galaxy. So, keep your eyes peeled and, whatever you do, never step on one of their tails.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"September 22, 2026","publish_date_short":"Sep in our galaxy, the dog-like creatures of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e make great best friends. Some may look like monsters, and some might actually \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003ebe\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e monsters, but all of them are fond of a gentle pat on the head and a yummy treat. These creatures aren’t exactly pups — some of them don’t even have a patch of fur — but they are just as steadfast as any canine pet on our own planet.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLet’s meet 10 of our favorite creature companions who live in the galaxy far, far away; whether they’re at the side of a scoundrel or a faithful friend of a Jedi, these good \"doggos\" all deserve a good belly rub.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-dogs-keibu-grogu_d95eb85f.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"Grogu and Keibu\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e1. Anooba (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCarnivorous canines known as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anooba\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eanooba\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are pack hunters who prey upon any creature they can catch unaware on their home planet in the Outer Rim. Anoobas have large, pointed ears well-suited for tracking their target. Despite their ferocity, anoobas can be trained by instructors willing to take the risk.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAn anooba named \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/marrok-creature\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMarrok\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is the loyal companion of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/kyuzo\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKyuzo\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e bounty hunter \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/embo\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEmbo\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e during the Clone Wars. Later, after the fall of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/galactic-empire\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEmpire\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Embo is accompanied by an anooba (and good girl) named \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/keibu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKeibu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, as seen in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-d830ec57-499e-498c-b6b3-2b85a18a5f51?cid=DTCI-Synergy-StarWars-Site-Acquisition-StarWars-US-DisneyPlus-NA-EN-BlogArticleEmbed-Generic-NA\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Wars: The M\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, now on Disney+\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/frogdog-main_2b5498ee.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,720\" alt=\"At Attin frogdog\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e2. At Attin frogdog (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Skeleton Crew\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile the physical characteristics of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/at-attin-frogdog\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003efrogdogs\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/at-attin\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAt Attin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are certainly more frog than dog, these generally genial creatures are loyal and loving companions. Bulging eyes on the top and nostrils on the side of their large head, hairless skin, short legs, and sharp canine teeth are their most noticeable features.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDuring the era of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-new-republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNew Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a frogdog lives a contented life with Mrs. Ikk in a peaceful neighborhood on At Attin in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-skeleton-crew\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Skeleton Crew\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ithorians\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIthorian\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e's young and mischievous neighbor \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/wim\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWim\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e often startles her beloved pet into barking.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/barghest-the-force-awakens_05649c80.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,529\" alt=\"Barghest in Star Wars: The Force Awakens.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e3. Barghest (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Force Awakens\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThey look absolutely terrifying with all those teeth and red eyes, but barghests are surprisingly loyal and genuine pets. Dozens of razor-sharp teeth fill a barghest's massive jaws, and its dark leathery skin only has a few patches of coarse fur. This is definitely a beast that doesn't fall under the category of \"cute.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBut that doesn't mean the barghest is a thoughtless brute. The four-legged, six-eyed canine-like creatures fiercely protect their companions from all kinds of danger. \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/gwellis-bagnoro\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGwellis Bagnoro\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, an expert forger who stopped by \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/mazs-castle\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMaz's Castle\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/takodana\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTakodana\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-vii-the-force-awakens\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Force Awakens\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, is one such fortunate owner.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/pages-from-art-of-thr-panel-selects-bell-ember_ff9f54d9.jpeg?region=0,0,989,1080\" alt=\"Bell Zettifar, Padawan of the High Republic, is often accompanied by his charhound buddy Ember.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e4. Charhound (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The High Republic\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCharhounds are found on the hot, dusty world of Elphrona. Like much of the iron-rich world itself, the small, four-legged creatures have muted colors of black, white, and grey. Spots of red and orange dot their hides. Their bright yellow eyes shine with intelligence. They have an amazing amount of stamina for an animal so lithe and quick. Charhounds also hide an unexpected trait for anyone who gets on their bad side.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/bell-zettifar\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBell Zettifar\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Padawan of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/the-high-republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe High Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, is often accompanied by his charhound buddy Ember. Like all good dogs, charhounds appreciate a nice scratch behind the ears, and Bell is always happy to oblige.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/select-deletedscene-2_solo_astarwarsstory_bns_corellian_8961b60b.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,720\" alt=\"Corellian hounds\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e5. Corellian Hound (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eSolo: A Star Wars Story\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eYou might not consider these canines good boys when they're hot on your trail (as seen in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/solo\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eSolo: A Star Wars Story\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e), but \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/corellian-hounds\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCorellian hounds\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are a mainstay of the industrial planet. A variety of breeds live across \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/corellia\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCorellia\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Sibians in particular are used for tracking and hunting thanks to their sensitive sense of smell and oversized teeth. The hairless creatures also have two wide set eyes and are surprisingly light on their feet.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNot even \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rebolt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRebolt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/syke\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSyke\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, handlers with the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/white-worms\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhite Worms\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, can resist giving the Sibian hounds some treats. Syke's favorite Sibian is named Taomat.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/trivia-andor-s2-trivia-elvis_717ae24f.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"The art department created a collar for the animatronic dog-like creature outside of the Ghorman Front headquarters.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e6. Ghor hound (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAndor A Star Wars Story\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGhor hounds are native to their namesake world in the Colonies. The domesticated canines have tough but soft wrinkled skin, sparse hair, large bat-like ears with grooved pinnae, and intelligent and expressive eyes.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA rescued Ghor hound named Elvis and his caring owner live together in the capital city of Palmo in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/andor\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAndor\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. They hunker down together during one of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ghorman\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGhorman's\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e most fraught moments in history, giving each other some much-needed comfort.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/ezra-bridger-loth-wolf_360de2eb.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Ezra found solace in the Loth-wolves that wandered the plains of Lothal.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e7. Loth-wolf (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNot much is known about the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/loth-wolf\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLoth-wolf\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a canine creature native to \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lothal\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLothal\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The mysterious wolf-like beings are deeply connected to the Force. Loth-wolves, often covered in white, black, or grey fur, are highly intelligent and can communicate with those strong in the Force. They've been intertwined with the planet's history for so long that there are even ancient paintings dedicated to the ghostly wolves.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile the standoffish Loth-wolves are too massive and wild to be pets, they do allow other beings to ride on their backs across the grassy plains of Lothal, as we see in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-rebels\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/quiz-perfect-pet-sw2-hero-mobile_40d2a1a3.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,720\" alt=\"Omega and Batcher\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e8. Lurca hound (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Bad Batch\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/wayland\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWayland's\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lurca-hound\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003elurca hounds\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e sport snub noses and a bony frill along the top of their heads that enhance the resonance of the canid's vocalizations. Lurca hounds patrol the area around the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/mount-tantiss\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMount Tantiss\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Imperial facility, but the massive and muscular creatures are difficult to domesticate. They're controlled through harsh methods, including stimulus collars, that do nothing to endear them to their droid handler \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/k-9x1\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eK-9X1\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA lurca hound designated LH-201 was held in the Imperial kennels at the Tantiss facility until \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/omega\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOmega\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-bad-batch\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Bad Batch\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e freed her. Renamed \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/batcher\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBatcher\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, she becomes a member of the Clone Force 99 family and finds a new home on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/pabu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePabu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, where she stays close by Omega's side.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/massiff-main_9f91bfb3.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,537\" alt=\"Massiff and The Mandalorian.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e9. Massiff (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe massiffs domesticated by \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tusken-raiders\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTusken Raiders\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tatooine\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTatooine\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are more reptilian than mammal. Republic clone troopers also tamed and trained massiffs to track their enemies during the Clone Wars. Scales and spikes cover their stout body, their large black eyes are well-suited for seeing in the dark, and their hide is thick and armored for defense. Jagged teeth poke out of their sizeable mouths.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDespite their aggressive appearance, massiffs love scritches and attention — just ask \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/the-mandalorian\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Mandalorian\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/vulptex-main_00c58a27.jpeg?region=0,0,1600,663\" alt=\"Vulptex from Star Wars: The Last Jedi.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cspan\u003e10. Vulptex (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Last Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe fox-like \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/vulptex\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003evulptices\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/crait\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCrait\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are easily identified by their shining crystalline fur. A group of vulptices, called a skulk, found a home in an abandoned rebel base on the desolate planet. The omnivorous animals survive by eating Craithian shrub grass and mole mice. Their small size, agile bodies, and acute eyesight give them the ability to reach the depths of the caverns where they're safe.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA vulptex isn't typically tamed or domesticated, but the curious canines helped Resistance members escape the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-first-order\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFirst Order\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, as seen in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-viii-the-last-jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Last \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrogu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in action.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn fact, Lucasfilm President and Chief Creative Officer Dave Filoni and Favreau worked with Disney Imagineers to update \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eMillennium Falcon: Smugglers Run\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e with characters from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, at the same time the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/bdx-droid\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBDX droids\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e that roam \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGalaxy's Edge,\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e made an appearance in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThere are several different generations of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e fans and all have different interests,” says Filoni. “We always look at how we are going to serve those different interests and — most importantly — how do we bring everyone together because we all have a common love of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. I think the park is a great place to do that.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/worldbuilders-jon-favreau-dave-filoni-favreau-grogu_35e92ccd.jpeg?region=0,0,1620,1080\" alt=\"Jon Favreau with Grogu on the set of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFavreau recognizes he has a unique role in building onto the legacy of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a galaxy he fell in love with as a child. \"I've been fortunate enough to be the steward of worlds that have come before and evolve them. That's a very specific type of worldbuilding,\" Favreau says in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eDisney Worldbuilders\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a new documentary now on Disney+.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBoth Filoni and Favreau say new \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e stories must honor a mix of the old and the new, which in many cases includes preserving what made the franchise so popular while incorporating new technology. And \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e creator George Lucas, who served as a key mentor for Filoni, is well-known for helping usher in new technological breakthroughs, not unlike Walt Disney, the dreamer behind Disneyland.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/worldbuilders-jon-favreau-dave-filoni-grogu-anzellans_a80ffa15.jpeg?region=0,0,1620,1080\" alt=\"Grogu and the Anzellan puppets on the set of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/worldbuilders-jon-favreau-dave-filoni-puppeteers_463e235d.jpeg?region=0,0,1620,1080\" alt=\"The puppeteers of Grogu and the Anzellan puppets on the set of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\"People think of Disney or Disneyland as nostalgic,\" says Favreau, \"but it's difficult to keep in mind how cutting edge all of that technology was when it was presented to the public.\" Part of maintaining the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Disneyland magic, while also moving it forward, relies on understanding that multiple generations of fans have grown up seeing \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e films and visiting Disney Parks.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/worldbuilders-jon-favreau-dave-filoni-filoni_0d159b3e.jpeg?region=0,0,1620,1080\" alt=\"Dave Filoni on set of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn addition to enjoying seeing strangers experience \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGalaxy's Edge\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Filoni also finds inspiration visiting the parks, especially on trips with Favreau.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\"We always come out of it excited,\" says Filoni. “Walking into \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGalaxy’s Edge\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is incredible every time I go, and one of the greatest things is seeing other people reacting to it. You take in these moments of joy that people have seeing the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eMillennium Falcon\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e there in reality…It completely affects the way you do your job. You leave the park at the end of the day feeling ‘I’m back in touch with what initially I loved about this’ because of people being in that galaxy with you. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“It’s very special to me and makes me feel like a kid again,” he continues. “That’s what the park itself gives you — this energy and commitment to play and imagination. You can’t get that anywhere else.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe
