href=\"https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-e1234eda-704c-4729-a47e-e8be088bc61f?cid=DTCI-Synergy-StarWars-Site-Acquisition-StarWars-US-DisneyPlus-NA-EN-BlogArticleEmbed-Generic-NA\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ehas arrived to Disney+\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, an epic retelling of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eseries as we know it.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSurrounded by friends from every season of life (and their series), \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-mandalorian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Din Djarin\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDin Djarin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrogu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e find themselves at the center of celebration and storytelling. With a party full of eager listeners, the group of familiar faces relive the many adventures that shaped this clan of two. Piecing together the legendary history of this perfect pair is no easy task, but somehow it all just clicks.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThis refreshing take fit for fans of all ages is chock-full of Easter eggs and callbacks that you won’t want to miss! Here are a few of our favorite callouts…\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-friends_20cfa622.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Omera and her daughter Winta from The Mandalorian Chapter 4: “Sanctuary” in LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e1. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eI have friends everywhere.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e No party is complete without friends to share it with, and this is no exception. Joining in on the festivities are none other than Resistance pilot \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/carson-teva\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Carson Teva\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCarson Teva\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, as well as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/omera\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Omera\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOmera\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and her daughter \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/winta\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Winta\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWinta\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChapter 4: “Sanctuary.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-r5-d4_68af3eca.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"R5-D4 once again gets his top blown off, following a nearly identical fate to his debut in Star Wars: A New Hope.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e2. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOff with his head! \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/r5-d4\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"R5-D4\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eR5-D4\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e once again gets his top blown off, following a nearly identical fate to his debut in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-iv-a-new-hope\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: A New Hope\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: A New Hope\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Thank goodness LEGO includes building instructions.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-banners_b1bf0f3c.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"The banners used to spruce up the shindig read “This is the Way,” and “We love Grogu.”\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e3. Dedicated decorations.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Speaking for the Mandalorians (but also all of us), the banners used to spruce up the shindig read “This is the Way” and “We love Grogu.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-snack_b8f68188.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Grogu is seen devouring a tasty frog snack.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e4. Never enough nummies. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWith a stomach almost as big as his heart, it comes as no surprise that Grogu is seen devouring a tasty frog snack.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-ig-11_a8e0beb9.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"IG-11 showcases the iconic “Robot” dance.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e5. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBlame it on the boogie! \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSwift with his moves and his blaster, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ig-11\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"IG-11\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIG-11\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e isn’t afraid to pop and lock. IG-11 showcases the iconic “Robot” dance popularized in the 1980s, a moment by\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003erequest of Director Chris Buckley. (Some of the younger members of the crew did not initially understand the reference.)\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-separator_6824e9bc.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Jawas can be spotted utilizing a standard LEGO brick separator.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e6. Stripped, not destroyed.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Jawas can be spotted utilizing the most powerful tool in the galaxy, a standard LEGO brick separator, to tear apart Din Djarin’s ship.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-binary-sunset_25b90f5e.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Grogu uses the Force to defeat the mudhorn.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e7. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNostalgic notes.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e You can catch a snippet of John Williams’ original “Binary Sunset Theme” from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: A New Hope\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e playing as Grogu uses \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-force\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"the Force\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Force\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e to defeat the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/mudhorn\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"mudhorn\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003emudhorn\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The classic theme always delivers.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-instruction-bookl_e5ba12de.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Jawas need to enlist the help of a LEGO instruction booklet.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e8. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBrick solid.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Even Jawas need to enlist the help of a LEGO instruction booklet from time to time. In this case, it’s used to rebuild the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/razor-crest\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Razor Crest\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eRazor Crest\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e returning the ship to its original state. Jawas — they’re just like us!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-peli_2ec377db.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Peli hoists Grogu in a grandiose gesture.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e9. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLong live the baby. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIt’s all hakuna matata when \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/peli-motto\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Peli Motto\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePeli Motto\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is around. Just like Rafiki from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Lion King\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Peli hoists Grogu in a grandiose gesture because we would all like to see the baby. And can you blame her? He has a face fit for a king.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-minikit_9fa3a947.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Jawas are caught sneaking off with a collectible minikit item from the Mandalorian’s ship.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e10. This iconic podracer belongs to the Chosen One himself, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Anakin Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-at-st_171f246d.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"This scout walker is a match for the AT-ST impaled during the Battle of Endor in Star Wars: Return of the Jedi.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e16. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eYub nub.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Complete with giant logs and leftover leaves, this scout walker is a match for the AT-ST impaled during the Battle of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/endor\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Endor\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEndor\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Return of the Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Return of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Let’s just say that I would not want to get on an \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ewok\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Ewok\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEwok\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s bad side.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-mouse-droid_fa6c7c25.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Grogu is undeniably strong with the arts and seamlessly constructs a mouse droid.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e17. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBeauty is in the eye of the builder. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThough he is but a youngling, Grogu is undeniably strong with the arts. Seamlessly constructing a \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/mouse-droid\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"mouse droid\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003emouse droid\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/loth-cat\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Loth-cat\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLoth-cat\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/sorgan\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Sorgan\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSorgan\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e frog, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tie-fighter\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"TIE fighter\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTIE fighter\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e mini, and X-wing mini, his powers are unlimited.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-ig-12_ec8556cd.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"the Anzellans deliver IG-12 using their ship from Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e18. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBig ship, huh? \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMaking their appearance in style, the Anzellans deliver IG-12 using their ship from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/Star-Wars-The-Mandalorian-and-Grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/lego-star-wars-the-mandalorian-trivia-chewbacca_e5497a17.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"The newly adopted Din Grogu shares his elations with a fierce roar that mirrors that of Chewbacca at the end of Star Wars: A New Hope.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e19. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBattle cry. \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHe may be tiny, but he is mighty! Skywa\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003elker\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci W\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ears: The E\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003empire Strikes Back\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile the fussy \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/c-3po\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eC-3PO\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e would never consider permanently covering up his signature golden plating, sometimes a situation calls for a little discretion. On \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/kijimi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Kijimi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKijimi\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in the era of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-first-order\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the First Order\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe First Order\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/poe-dameron\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Poe Dameron\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePoe Dameron\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e grabs four overcoats from an Opranko guildhouse and gives one to the shiny \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/protocol-droid\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"protocol droid\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eprotocol droid\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. In the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-ix-the-rise-of-skywalker\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003efinal film in the Skywalker saga\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Threepio dons the thick overcoat to keep from bringing unwanted attention to himself and his friends.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/well-dressed-droids-c3po-chewie_0a350adb.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,798\" alt=\"C-3PO has also been worn like clothing, slung over Chewbacca’s back on Cloud City while the dependable Wookiee finished repairing him.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNotably, C-3PO has also been worn like clothing, slung over \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/chewbacca\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Chewbacca\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChewbacca\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s back on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/cloud-city\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Cloud City\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCloud City\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e while the dependable \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/wookiee\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Wookiee\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWookiee\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e finished repairing him in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-v-the-empire-strikes-back\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe original trilogy sequel\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. And the droid has been known to hold Chewie’s bandolier and satchel… from time to time.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/well-dressed-droids-droid-gotra-chase_a9f740f0.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"Droid Gotra in Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDroid Gotra in \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar W\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ears: T\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ehe Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Droid Gotra is a union of independent droids that functions as a crime syndicate, mercenary group, and a self-described organization dedicated to droid liberation and emancipation. Droids pieced together from aged Clone Wars combatants and other parts make up the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hutt\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Twins’ fighting force hired to guard their compound on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/nal-hutta\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Nal Hutta\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNal Hutta\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in the era of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-new-republic\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the New Republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe New Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/well-dressed-droids-droid-gotra-pilot_945baa96.jpeg?region=0,209,1545,871\" alt=\"Droid Gotra pilot in Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTo emphasize their free will and individuality, members of the Gotra wear crude cloaks and other loose-fitting garments. Catch them in action now in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, available on digital and 4K Ultra HD.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/well-dressed-droids-tros-al1-l3_f229a40e.jpeg?region=0,0,1080,1080\" alt=\"AL1-L3 in Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAL1-L3 in \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar Wars:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eThe Rise of Skywalker\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA cargo hauler who goes by the name “Allie” during the time of the New Republic, the former protocol droid wears a striped banner from the Droid Gotra as a serape. Allie wears it slung over one shoulder in a casual style that suggests she lives a life of freedom.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIt’s a powerful statement for a droid who spent years confined to the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/kessel\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Kessel\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKessel\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/spice\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"spice\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003espice\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e mines, where she was inspired to gain her independence after a brief spark of droid revolution.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/well-dressed-droids-ahsoka-hk-87-assassian-droid_dce2b523.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"HK-87 Assassin Droid in Ahsoka\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eHK-87 Assassin Droid in \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar War\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003es: T\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ehe Mandalorian \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eand \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAhsoka\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHK-87 droids are typically programmed as ruthless assassins. A pair of HK-87 droids in the magistrate’s service on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/corvus\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Corvus\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCorvus\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e serve as bodyguards and drape long, black half-cloaks over their broad torsos. The dramatic fashion choice gives the merciless droids an even more menacing appearance both during their debut in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/the-mandalorian\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and their resurgence in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-ahsoka\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAhsoka\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/well-dressed-droids-ig-11-kuill_8abfb149.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"IG-11 in Star Wars: The Mandalorian\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eI\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eG-11\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e in \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\n\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile assassin droids \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ig-11\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIG-11\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ig-88\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"IG-88\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIG-88\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are both fond of wearing bandoliers, it’s a very special accessory that earns IG-11 a spot on this list. After he’s reprogrammed by the inimitable \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/kuiil\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Kuiil\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKuiil\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the bounty h\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eunter\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e-turned-babysitter droid keeps \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrogu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e safely snuggled against his chest. latest wave of autograph guests just revealed.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/swcla-2027-guests-freddie-prince-jr-vanessa-marshall-ti_0c05ea9d.jpeg?region=0,0,1400,593\" alt=\"Freddie Prinze Jr., Vanessa Marshall, and Tiya Sircar\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSpectre 1 is reporting in for Celebration LA! The voice of Jedi Kanan Jarrus, Freddie Prinze Jr., will be reuniting with the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew for the event. Prinze voiced Kanan in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-rebels\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars Rebels\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-rise-of-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-bad-batch\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Bad Batch\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Bad Batch\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e — where he played a younger version of Kanan, then known as Caleb \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDume\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEveryone’s favorite space mom will also be joining the fun in Los Angeles. Vanessa Marshall voiced \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRebel\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Alliance\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e hero and ace pilot \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hera-syndulla\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hera Syndulla\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHera Syndulla\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eLEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Forces of Destiny\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-squadrons\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Squadrons\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Squadrons\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Bad Batch\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. More recently, Marshall has played Mandalorian warrior \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/Rook-Kast\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Rook Kast\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRook Kast\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Clone Wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/Star-Wars-Maul-Shadow-Lord\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTiya Sircar, who voiced the fiercely independent Mandalorian warrior \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/sabine-wren\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Sabine Wren\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSabine Wren\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, is heading to Celebration. Sircar played Sabine in all four seasons of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, as well as several episodes of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Forces of Destiny\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/swcla-2027-guests-taylor-gray-steve-blum-jim-cummings_89a0ee0f.jpeg?region=0,0,1400,593\" alt=\"Taylor Gray, Steve Blum, and Jim Cummings\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNo need to continue your search for Ezra — we’ve found him (again)! Taylor Gray is also heading to Celebration. Gray voiced \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ezra-bridger\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Ezra Bridger\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEzra Bridger\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, who sometimes went by the alias \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jabba-the-hutt\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jabba the Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJabba the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and an episode of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Forces of Destiny\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKarabast! \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCelebration wouldn't be complete without Steve Blum — the voice of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLasat\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e warrior with a heart of gold, Garazeb Orrelios. Blum has voiced Orrelios, or Zeb to his friends, in several productions including \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/the-mandalorian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Mandalorian\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and most recently the theatrical film \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Mandalorian and \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGrogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e, \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003enow available on digital and 4K Ultra HD. He’s also played other \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e characters in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Resistance\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Visions\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEvery party is better with a pirate aboard! Jim Cummings, the voice of space pirate \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hondo-ohnaka\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hondo Ohnaka\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHondo Ohnaka\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, will also join the crew for Celebration. Cummings has voiced Hondo in animation, video games, and attractions at Disney Parks, including \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Outlaws\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eMil\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003elenn\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eium Falcon\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e: Smugglers Run\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eStars from all across the Skywalker Saga, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and Lucasfilm Animation are headed to \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCelebration Los Angeles in the latest wave of autograph guests just revealed.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-celebration-la-guests-wayne-crowder-2-up_58b90ecf.jpeg?region=0,0,961,601\" alt=\"Brendan Wayne and Lateef Crowder\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBrendan Wayne and Lateef Crowder have worked with Pedro Pascal wearing the armor of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-mandalorian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Din Djarin\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDin Djarin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e since \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s first season and all three were featured in this summer’s film \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/Star-Wars-The-Mandalorian-and-Grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Wayne’s work established Din Djarin's gunslinger rhythm while Crowder portrayed Djarin during combat-focused scenes.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnd returning to \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Celebration are a dangerous Imperial Warlord and two formidable Mandalorian warriors.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-celebration-la-guests-esposito-sackhoff-swall_0014b806.jpeg?region=0,0,1380,593\" alt=\"Giancarlo Esposito, Katee Sackoff, and Emily Swallow\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGiancarlo Esposito will join in on the fun at Los Angeles next year. Esposito played \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/moff-gideon\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Moff Gideon\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMoff Gideon\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e — an Imperial warlord during \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-new-republic\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the New Republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe New Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e era working on a secret cloning project — in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKatee Sackhoff brought her character \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/bo-katan-kryze\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Bo-Katan Kryze\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBo-Katan Kryze\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e to the screen first in animation in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Clone Wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-rebels\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars Rebels\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and later in live action with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandaloria\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003en. She most recently voiced Kryze in an episode of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/tales-of-the-empire\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Tales of the Empire\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Tales of the Empire\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEmily Swallow, who plays the character only known as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-armorer\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"The Armorer\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Armorer\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, will also attend the event. Swallow has worn the Armorer’s unique gold helmet in both \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/the-mandalorian\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/the-book-of-boba-fett\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Book of \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eBo\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eba F\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eett\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-celebration-la-2027-celebrity-guests-best-woo_9e4a4016.jpeg?region=0,0,1000,625\" alt=\"Ahmed Best and Matthew Wood\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhmed Best, who has brought both \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jar-jar-binks\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jar Jar Binks\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJar Jar Binks\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Jedi Master \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/kelleran-beq\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Kelleran Beq\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKelleran Beq\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e to life in the prequel trilogy and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/the-mandalorian\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e will be at \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Celebration 2027. Best recently co-wrote the comic one-shot\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Star Wars: Jar Jar\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e (2026) that showed the consequences Binks faced after giving Chancellor Palpatine emergency powers.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe voice of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/general-grievous\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"General Grievous\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGeneral Grievous\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sith\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Revenge of the Sith\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Clone Wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e, \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMatthew Wood will also be at the event. Wood is also a supervising sound editor and sound designer at Skywalker Sound.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-celebration-la-2027-celebrity-guests-eckstein_2bfa1e46.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,542\" alt=\"Ashley Eckstein, James Arnold Taylor, and Matt Lanter\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe voices of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ahsoka-tano\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Ahsoka Tano\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhsoka Tano\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Anakin Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/obi-wan-kenobi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Obi-Wan Kenobi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eObi-Wan Kenobi\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eClone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e are reuniting again at Celebration!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAshley Eckstein has voiced Ahsoka Tano in animation for almost twenty years, starting with the 2008 film \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and the seven seasons of the animated series that followed it. Eckstein has also voiced Tano in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-rebels\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars Rebels\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/tales-of-the-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Tales of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and most recently, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.disneyplus.com/whats-on/entity-8adeb478-c15d-47a2-b2fb-e3653e2f75a3\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eLEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSay ‘Hello there!’ to James Arnold Taylor. Taylor voiced Obi-Wan Kenobi in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and several \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e LEGO specials. He also voiced characters in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-battlefront-ii\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Battlefront II\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-squadrons\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Squadrons\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Squadrons\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/lego-star-wars-the-skywalker-saga\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eLEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRounding out the trio is Matt Lanter, the voice of Anakin Skywalker in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Lanter has also voiced Anakin in several \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e video games, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Forces of Destiny\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Tales of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and many recent LEGO \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e specials. And in live action, Lanter played a New Republic officer in an episode of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-celebration-la-2027-celebrity-guests-christen_c3eba135.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,566\" alt=\"Hayden Christensen, Ian McDiarmid, and Anthony Daniels\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Chosen One himself, Hayden Christensen, who made his \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e debut playing \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Anakin Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-ii-attack-of-the-clones\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Attack of the Clones\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Attack of the Clones\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e,\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is coming to Celebration. Christensen reprised the dual role of Anakin Skywalker/\u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Darth Vader\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in the limited series \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/obi-wan-kenobi\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eOb\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003ei-W\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003ean Kenobi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and later appeared as Anakin in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-ahsoka\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAhsoka\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSeason 1.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFor fans of the Empire, the Emperor will also be in attendance at \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCelebration! Actor Ian McDiarmid has played \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/emperor-palpatine-darth-sidious\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Emperor Palpatine\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEmperor Palpatine\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-v-the-empire-strikes-back\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Empire Strikes Back\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Return of the Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Return of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e,\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e the prequel trilogy, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-rise-of-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnthony Daniels will be appearing in Los Angeles in 2027, marking the 50th anniversary of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-iv-a-new-hope\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: A New Hope\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: A New Hope\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e where he made his debut in the franchise. Daniels has played the \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eprotoc\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eol dr\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eoid\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/c-3po\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"C-3PO\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eC-3PO\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in ten films and has also brought C-3PO to life in several live-action and animated appearances, including \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAhsoka\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e the series and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eLEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-celebration-la-2027-celebrity-guests-baker-an_5b9c01e5.jpeg?region=0,0,1000,625\" alt=\"Dee Bradley Baker and Michelle Ang\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFrom Lucasfilm Animation, Dee Bradley Baker is joining the fun in Los Angeles. Baker has voiced countless characters in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e productions over the years, including all the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/clone-troopers\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"clone troopers\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eclone troopers\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Clone Wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-bad-batch\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Bad Batch\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Bad Batch\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e.\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnd joining Baker once again is his co-star Michelle Ang, who voiced \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/omega\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Omega\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOmega\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Bad Batch\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. With Ang at \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Celebration, come meet the entire Clone Force 99 before.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eCaisson\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hyperdrive\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"hyperdrive\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ehyperdrive\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is primed and ready. A team of carefully selected recruits is on standby, waiting for orders to deploy. \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eYour\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e orders. Get ready to take command in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/Star-Wars-Zero-Company\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars Zero Company\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a new single-player turn-based tactics game set during \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/eras#era4\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Clone Wars\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIf you’ve never played turn-based tactics before and you’re feeling a little daunted leading your own squad, don’t worry. You're not alone. The first ever \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e tactics game, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is made for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e fans of all gaming experience levels. Not only will tutorials and on-screen tips show you the ropes as you take control of your team, but you can also adjust the difficulty rating at any time outside of combat to curate the challenges you face.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnd right here on StarWars.com, we have a guide to getting started. By the time you’re done reading you’ll feel like you can take on the whole Separatist Army yourself.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLet’s zero in!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-gameplay-trailer-screenshots-swz_df562c65.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Tel-Rea gameplay in Star Wars Zero Company.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWhat Is a Turn-Based Tactics Game?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn a turn-based tactics game, combat is a little different from real-time action-adventure games like \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-jedi-fallen-order\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Jedi: Fallen Order\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and the sequel \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/star-wars-jedi-survivor\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eJedi: Survivor\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The action pauses while you decide what each character, known as operators in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eZero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, will do next. After you choose an action for the operator, the result is determined immediately. And once your operators make their moves, it’s your opponent’s turn to choose theirs.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/4MG48L7qYHE\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEach operator has health points, along with three action points (AP) to move, attack, and use abilities during their turn. When making battle decisions for each operator, you can:\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eMove\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: Spend AP to move to a location in range and take cover if possible. The game automatically indicates where you can move and how many AP it will cost to get there.\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"2\"\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAttack\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: Spend the listed AP to fight an enemy with a ranged or melee attack. Unsure which enemy to strike? Don’t worry, the game automatically targets the foe you have the best chance of hitting.\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"3\"\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCall for Backup\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: Operators can call for an assist. A nearby teammate adds their attack to theirs, inflicting additional damage on their target.\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"4\"\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOverwatch\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: Spend any remaining AP to hold your position for a reaction attack. During your opponent’s turn, an operator on overwatch strikes an enemy that moves or acts inside the target area.\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"5\"\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRally\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: Get an injured operator back on their feet. They gain one injury every time they go down; three injuries result in their death if you have permadeath mode on.\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"6\"\u003e\n\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSpecial Actions\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: The most powerful abilities cost Advantage points, tracked in the bottom left of the screen. Operators gain Advantage points when they inflict damage on an enemy during combat.\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eYour objectives for the mission are listed in the top left and marked on the map. Complete these to successfully finish the operation!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-guide-gameplay-flow_b9a110f8.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1200\" alt=\"Star Wars Zero Company gameplay flow graphic\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAll in a Cycle’s Work\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, you play as former Republic Officer \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/Hawks\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hawks\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHawks\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, gathering unconventional allies to take on a dangerous cult called \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/The-Infinite-Coil\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"The Infinite Coil\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Infinite Coil\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/The-Den\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"The Den\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Den\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a decommissioned cargo freighter permanently docked at the Ring of Kafrene, is Zero Company’s home base. At the Den’s Holotable, Hawks chooses between the tactical missions and operations available for the current cycle.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMissions utilize a team of experienced operators to get a contracted job done through turn-based combat. Difficulty ranges from Risky to Dangerous to Extreme, so consider which operators are healthy and available before sending them on more difficult jobs. Missions marked as Critical advance the game’s story.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-guide-holotable-strategy_c31d9406.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"The holotable seen in Star Wars Zero Company.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOperations are non-combat assignments that require spending Intel points, which can be acquired through completing missions and obtaining information. For example, using the PICO-5 electroscope when Hawks is scouting in the field might reward Intel. These brief missions reward you with items, credits, and influence across the galaxy. Certain operations can also strengthen or weaken bonds between your team.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eYou can’t take on every mission or operation, so choose carefully where you’d like to focus your squad and their efforts.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-gameplay-trailer-screenshots-swz_fbe4c5c3.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Droid gameplay in Star Wars Zero Company.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTips for Getting Started\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli value=\"1\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTake your time making your next move during combat. While you and your allies and enemies might appear to be exchanging blaster fire, no damage gets inflicted until an action is taken during a turn.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"1\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eYou don’t have to take out all the enemies on the battlefield to succeed in your mission – unless explicitly stated in your mission objectives!\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli value=\"2\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePermadeath is optional, but this is one time we encourage it. Losing key operators adds to the emotional impact of the story, and makes for new challenges as you continue to play.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli value=\"1\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eYou can always restart a mission through the game menu to try a new strategy with the same operators.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli value=\"1\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTalk to your teammates in the Den regularly to learn more about their backstories and unlock missions that have personal meaning to them.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli value=\"1\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMissions advance you to the next cycle, so make sure you get everything done in the Den before you deploy the squad.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-gameplay-trailer-feature_70a08209.jpeg?region=0,0,1600,900\" alt=\"Star Wars Zero Company key art\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC in Standard, Deluxe, and Collector’s Editions.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnd pick up the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company Original Video Game Soundtrack\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, featuring music by Grammy®-winning composer Gordy Haab, from \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWalt Disney Records\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The soundtrack is available now on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://open.spotify.com/prerelease/4RnG1CTGDql4MMuWcvwL2R?si=UyyzZRRLTbGem0Sw13JLIQ\u0026amp;utm_source=copy-link\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSpotify\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://music.apple.com/us/album/star-wars-zero-company-original-video-game-soundtrack/6793246073?at=1010lKkZ\u0026amp;ct=album_6793246073\u0026amp;ls=1\u0026amp;itscg=30200\u0026amp;itsct=toolbox_linkbuilder\u0026amp;mttnsubad=6793246073\u0026amp;app=music\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eApple Music\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca
