Champion\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eFrom the sands of Tatooine to the fighting pits of Shakari, Rotta the Hutt must fight for his place in the galaxy beyond his family’s shadow.\u003c/span\u003e","summary":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFrom the sands of Tatooine to the fighting pits of Shakari, Rotta the Hutt must fight for his place in the galaxy beyond his family’s shadow.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFrom the moment the original \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003etrilogy introduced \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jabba-the-hutt\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jabba the Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJabba the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e — a mere mention in the first film before the era of the Special Editions — his standing in the galaxy was clear. Known as one of the most powerful gangsters, Jabba held heavy influence in the criminal underworld from his palace in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tatooine\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Tatooine\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTatooine\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/dune-sea\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Dune Sea\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDune Sea\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. But Jabba was more than just a top crime lord; he also had a family, including his son, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rotta-the-huttlet\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Rotta the Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRotta the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThere’s been a lot of love for Rotta the Hutt lately, mainly due to his appearance in all his full-muscled glory in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/Star-Wars-The-Mandalorian-and-Grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, now available on digital. But what makes Rotta so irresistible?\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eHumble beginnings\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image media-image-inline\" style=\"margin-left: 1rem; float: right; max-width: 40%;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/rotta-the-huttlet-concept-jon-favreau_1476db5f.jpeg?region=0,0,1023,1080\" alt=\"A concept model of Rotta the Huttlet painted by Jon Favreau.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003cfigcaption style=\" text-align: center;\"\u003eA concept model of Rotta the Huttlet painted by Jon Favreau.\u003c/figcaption\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIt was Director Jon Favreau’s handpainted concept model of Rotta that reminded me just how cute the Huttlet was when we first met him. Debuting in animation in the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-the-clone-wars\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Clone Wars\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e feature film, the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hutt\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e nicknamed Stinky by \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ahsoka-tano\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Ahsoka Tano\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhsoka Tano\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is just a kid who has lots of growing up to do. We may not all have a famous father, but Rotta’s coming of age is still familiar, especially when it comes to having to figure out your place in the world.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHeir apparent to the Hutt empire, the 2008 animated film secured his place as a certified little guy. At just about 10 years of age, young Rotta is barely old enough to slither himself across the desert when he is kidnapped as part of a grand scheme to force the Hutts to join the Clone Wars. While \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Anakin Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Ahsoka are tasked with rescuing Rotta, the mystery behind his kidnapping unravels on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/coruscant\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Coruscant\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCoruscant\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, revealing a nefarious plot from Jabba’s own uncle, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ziro-the-hutt\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Ziro the Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZiro the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/count-dooku\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Count Dooku\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCount Dooku\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWe like to think that his safe return to the palace led to a childhood spent listening to the likes of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-max-rebo-band\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"The Max Rebo Band\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Max Rebo Band\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, exploring the labyrinthine tunnels surrounding the throne room, and doing baby Hutt things.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv mh-tiktok-node-alignment=\"center\" mh-tiktok-node-src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7641730399609097503\" class=\"mh-tiktok\" style=\"justify-content: center; display: flex;\"\u003e\n\u003cblockquote class=\"tiktok-embed\" data-video-id=\"7641730399609097503\" data-embed-from=\"oembed\" cite=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7641730399609097503\" style=\"margin: 0px; padding: 0px; max-width: 325px;\"\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7641730399609097503\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/blockquote\u003e\n\u003cscript src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/embed.js\" id=\"mh-social-widget-script\" async=\"\"\u003e\u003c/script\u003e\n\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eJabba’s Shadow\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBut his story didn’t end there  — and his father’s long shadow and the ire from his extended family continue to be themes throughout Rotta’s life and into adulthood.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSpoiler warning: The following article contains plot points and story details from \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFor Rotta, the unscrupulous heritage left behind following his father’s death in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Return of the Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Return of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is a heavy one. Jabba had his sticky hands in all sorts of criminal activity, from illegal \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/spice\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"spice\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003espice\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e trade to gambling. His money and power ensured that people across the galaxy knew who he was and what he could do. That kind of lasting presence and a family legacy built on fear and power makes it difficult for a child to establish himself as an individual.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-rotta-the-hutt-figh_55204d4e.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"Rotta fights in the Shakari arena known as the Pits.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA few years later, after the fall of the Empire, we catch up to Rotta in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Set on establishing himself as his own man and wanting nothing to do with taking Jabba’s throne, he’s left Jabba’s legacy and the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hutt-clan\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hutt Clan\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHutt clan\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e behind, finding himself on the world of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/Shakari\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Shakari\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eShakari\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a planet where the criminal underworld reigns supreme.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn the fluorescent lighting of the cityscape, Rotta is given a unique opportunity to establish himself as an individual. He makes a deal with Lord Janu, a man with a prime spot of power in the criminal underworld, to fight in the Shakari arena known as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/The-Pits\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"The Pits\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Pits\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. And as a gladiator under a slightly dubious contract, Rotta manages to establish his own identity.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-rotta-the-hutt-aren_bb8e98a6.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"The Shakari arena known as the Pits.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eComing into his own\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn the beginning, Rotta was booed by spectators, but he was fully committed to separating himself from Jabba’s reputation. And eventually, things changed when he became a champion.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“They slowly began to cheer. They realized I'm not my father,” Rotta tells \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-mandalorian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Din Djarin\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDin Djarin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. “I'm my own man. And I'm not afraid to fight for what I have. To earn it. To prove myself to everyone.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-rotta-the-hutt-cage_9be01000.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"Rotta meets Grogu.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhere Jabba sat in his sprawling palace and ruled his empire with an iron fist, Rotta proves he doesn’t need the elaborate trappings to know his worth. He’s comfortable even within the confines of a glorified cage, and fights in the Pits for sport and glory.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFor a Hutt who grew up in the shadow of his crimelord dad, Rotta has built something that is all his own — something that isn’t just confined to the Pits of Shakari, either.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOnce he leaves the arena behind, setbacks could make it all too easy to fall into his father’s world of violence and power. But Rotta is resilient and able to embrace a new path. Rotta proves over and over that he’s truly made a name for himself.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHe puts his newfound fighting skills to good use to protect his friends. And his gentle nature, unlike his father’s brutal character, allows him to befriend Din and little \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrogu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. He shares snacks with Grogu during their first meeting and later spends time with the young foundling playing on the beach and napping together — activities that are difficult to imagine Jabba ever doing. (We never once saw him frolic or share a tasty morsel.)\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-rotta-the-hutt-adel_c9fd8785.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"Rotta with the New Republic on Adelphi Base.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRotta’s choice to reject his father’s path has shaped him into a Hutt that has a very different future ahead — one that may involve working with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-new-republic\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the New Republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe New Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e as a unique new recruit.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRotta has escaped his father’s shadow and carved out his own spot in the galaxy.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-watch-at-home\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBring home \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e on digital now, on 4K Ultra HD August 25, and streaming on Disney+ September 2.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"August 20, 2026","publish_date_short":"Aug new\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Star Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003evideo game arrives on August 27, 2026.\u003c/span\u003e","summary":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTake command of an elite squad when the new\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Star Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003evideo game arrives on August 27, 2026.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEvery move counts.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBit Reactor, in collaboration with Electronic Arts and Lucasfilm Games, has revealed the final trailer for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/games-apps/Star-Wars-Zero-Company\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars Zero Company\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e! The single-player turn-based tactics game puts you in charge of an unconventional outfit of professionals for hire operating in the shadows of the Clone Wars. Their existence may not be widely known, but their mission is vital — and so are your choices on the battlefield.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/Q-pQE8dUV_g\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe final trailer takes us into the shadows of the Clone Wars for a glimpse of the menacing but charismatic leader of the Infinite Coil, Kundri Fathom. Zero Company will do whatever it takes to stop her from spreading a deadly plague across the galaxy, including flying their ship straight into a volcano. (Don’t worry - M-3VO has got this.) Glimpses of gameplay show the squad in action as they give it everything they’ve got on the battlefield. From team members to weapons to abilities, every decision is yours to make.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-final-trailer-copy-of-swzc-launc_60ba0386.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Hawks contemplates the mission.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-final-trailer-copy-of-swzc-launc_e5db9637.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"The Infinite Coil gathers.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, you play as former Republic officer \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/Hawks\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hawks\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHawks\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and gather unconventional allies, including a clone trooper voiced by the legendary Dee Bradley Baker, a Mandalorian of the ancient Clan Verminoth, a Tognath Jedi Padawan, and more to form your squad. Work alongside ranks of hard-nosed recruits, known as Operators, to find Fathom and put an end to the threat the Infinite Coil poses to the entire galaxy.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHawks and their hired Operators can be created from eight iconic \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e species: \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/devaronian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Devaronian\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDevaronian\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Human, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/neimoidian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Neimoidian\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNeimoidian\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Ovissian, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/togruta\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Togruta\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTogruta\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Twi’lek, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/weequay\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Weequay\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWeequay\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and Zabrak. Customize the voices, attire, specializations, and talents of your crew. It's up to you to oversee Operators and put together the best squad for the mission at hand. Inside The Den, your base of operations, you’ll recruit, progress, and dispatch Operators from an ever-changing galaxy map, upgrade facilities, and purchase new equipment. Develop bonds on the battlefield with your squad to unlock new support abilities, including cross-training benefits that improve Operator abilities and stats.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-final-trailer-copy-of-swzc-launc_126b6f25.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Jae uses the Scattergun.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-zero-company-final-trailer-copy-of-swzc-launc_226a0f69.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Luco throws a concussion grenade.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\"Our team has poured everything we love about \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e into \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eZero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e,\" said Greg Foertsch, CEO and Creative Director at Bit Reactor. \"We've worked hand-in-hand with Lucasfilm Games to create an authentic \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e story packed with unique new characters, robust character customization, a new ship, Separatist Droids, and much more, all rooted in the conflict of the Clone Wars.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e delivers an entirely new experience in the galaxy and for our fans,” says Douglas Reilly, VP and GM of Lucasfilm Games. “It pairs cinematic storytelling with strategic gameplay in a way that feels fresh for the franchise. Some of the most interesting stories come from new perspectives, and Zero Company explores the Clone Wars from deep within the shadows of the conflict, through a lens we haven’t seen before, while still feeling completely authentic to the world fans know.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/ksOBF-T5LrA\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.ea.com/games/starwars/zero-company\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePre-order \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Standard Edition for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S or get the Deluxe Edition, available on PC and consoles, to unlock two additional unique cosmetic packs and five painted weapon themes inspired by the Clone Wars era. All pre-orders grant access to the Crystalline Astromech Cosmetic Pack, which includes an R3 droid, translucent \"crystalline\" astromech heads for the R4 and R5 droid variants, and the BR-1 droid, originating in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Zero Company\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Gosling is Kade Auberon in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Starfighter\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e","headline":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRyan Gosling is Kade Auberon in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Starfighter\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eThe star took the stage with Director Shawn Levy to tease the next \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003efeature film arriving Memorial Day 2027.\u003c/span\u003e","summary":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe star took the stage with Director Shawn Levy to tease the next \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003efeature film arriving Memorial Day 2027.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLong before he joined the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003egalaxy, Ryan Gosling was a proud member of the Mickey Mouse Club.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDuring the Disney Studio Showcase Panel at \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://d23.com/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eD23\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Ultimate Disney Fan Event\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Gosling revisited his early career, sporting a Mickey Mouse Club jacket similar to the one seen in a vintage video clip played for the delighted crowd. “I owe a lot to Disney,” Gosling said. “Had they not looked far and wide and come to my hometown, I would not be here today. And now here I am 30 years later… I’m back and it’s changing my life again.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv mh-tiktok-node-alignment=\"center\" mh-tiktok-node-src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7674136665421614367\" class=\"mh-tiktok\" style=\"justify-content: center; display: flex;\"\u003e\n\u003cblockquote class=\"tiktok-embed\" data-video-id=\"7674136665421614367\" data-embed-from=\"oembed\" cite=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7674136665421614367\" style=\"margin: 0px; padding: 0px; max-width: 325px;\"\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7674136665421614367\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/blockquote\u003e\n\u003cscript src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/embed.js\" id=\"mh-social-widget-script\" async=\"\"\u003e\u003c/script\u003e\n\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSwitching into a new jacket inspired by \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-starfighter-cast\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ehis \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStarfighter \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003echaracter, Kade Auberon\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, featuring an inverted symbol on the back of his character, Gosling offered hints at Kade’s journey to come. “Kade is a guy from the wrong side of the galaxy, whose fate is intertwined with the fastest starfighter ever built,” Gosling said before giving eager fans a feel for the character he plays through an exclusive first-look shown to the live audience.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/d23-star-wars-starfighter-shawn-levy_65710068.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1280\" alt=\"Shawn Levy at D23.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“I am so honored to release this film on the same weekend that the original film opened 50 years earlier,” \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-starfighter\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDirector Shawn Levy\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e said. Like \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e creator George Lucas, Levy was inspired by American car culture, and films like \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Outsiders\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Lucas’s \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAmerican Graffiti \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ewhen he was working on the film. “\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStarfighter\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e embodies the themes of hope, family and adventure that have always been core to \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, but our story takes place in a period of time that has never been seen before which has been a privilege to create and explore.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/sw-sop-featured-534jf84ks_2e2c554c.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Characters from Star Wars: Starfighter pose on a speeder\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStarfighter\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, when a cynical rogue is confronted by his mysterious past, he is hurled into a dangerous adventure across the galaxy that puts him on a crash course with destiny.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe film stars Gosling (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eDrive, Blade Runner, La La Land, Place Beyond the Pines, Barbie\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e) as Kade Auberon, as well as Flynn Gray, Matt Smith, Mia Goth, Aaron Pierre, Jamael Westman, Daniel Ings, and Amy Adams. \"This \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003estory is firmly rooted in character,  brought to life by these amazing actors,\" Levy said, \"and all within an adventure that's filled with humor, danger, spectacle and the joyous spirit that has been the beating heart of this 50 year legacy that we all love so much.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDirected by Shawn Levy, the film is produced by Levy and Kathleen Kennedy. Executive producers are Ryan Gosling, Mary McLaglen, Josh McLaglen, Dave Filoni, and Dan Levine. The script is by Jonathan Tropper.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Starfighter\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, an all-new standalone adventure, will be released theatrically May 28, 2027.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"August 15, 2026","publish_date_short":"Aug \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand Marvel Comics Unite in Historic Crossover Event\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eWritten by Kevin Smith, this with the Avengers, Spider-Man, and more.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Marvel Universe is coming to a galaxy far, far away.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLucasfilm and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.marvel.com/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMarvel\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e have announced \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles, \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe first-ever crossover between the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003euniverse and the Marvel Comics universe. Pop culture icon Kevin Smith will write the five-issue limited series, with art by David Marquez (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eUncanny X-Men\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e).\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand Marvel have a long history together: Marvel Comics published the first \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ecomics all the way back in 1977, and a 2015 relaunch kicked off a new era of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ecomics storytelling. But this five-issue limited series is something new, bringing \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eheroes and villains into the world of Marvel’s Earth-616, just in time for the 50th anniversary of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-iv-a-new-hope\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: A New Hope\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: A New Hope\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ein 2027.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“Back in the early 80’s, I had a subscription to Marvel’s \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e comics,” Smith says. “And as fun as it was to follow the continuing adventures of Luke, Leia, and Han, I always wished that Spider-Man or Doctor Doom could cross over into their cinematic saga. So when the opportunity arose to actually tell that story, nobody had to Force my hand! I’m ecstatic to be writing \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eHope Assembles\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e for the 50th anniversary of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e! Many thanks to Marvel Comics and Lucasfilm for trusting me to fly the Falcon \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eand\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e the Quinjet!”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-marvel-comics-crossover-hope-assembles-starwa_aedd6221.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,604\" alt=\"Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles cover line up\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe series follows Marvel heroes as they see the events of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eunfolding on Earth and before their very eyes, after a spell shatters reality. The Avengers, Spider-Man, and more will team up with heroes like \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/luke-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Luke Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLuke Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/leia-organa\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePrincess Leia\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/han-solo\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Han Solo\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHan Solo\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/chewbacca\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Chewbacca\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChewbacca\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, while Doctor Doom will align himself with the likes of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Darth Vader\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/galactic-empire\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Galactic Empire\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGalactic Empire\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\"Marvel and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars’\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e histories have been intertwined for 50 years and continue to set the standard for storytelling across the world… and across the media landscape,” says Marvel Comics Editor-in-Chief Stephen Wacker. “Lifelong lovers of both \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Marvel have a lot to look forward to as we finally bring the characters together in ways fans have been dreaming about for decades!\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“My time at Marvel has been filled with many 'dream come true' moments, but this \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eHope Assembles \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ecrossover is truly one of our proudest,” adds outgoing Marvel Comics Editor-in-Chief C.B. Cebulski. “It’s an idea we’ve wanted to explore since getting the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e license back over a decade ago, but we knew we’d have to wait with the patience of a Jedi to make it happen. The \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-50th-anniversary-theatrical-release\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003e50th anniversary of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eA\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e New\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Hope\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e has finally given us the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to bring these two universes together, in this incredible story being told by Kevin Smith and David Marquez. Getting the call with the green light from Lucasfilm was a magical moment; it was as if Han Solo himself had called to tell me, 'You’re all clear, kid!'”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"August 11, 2026","publish_date_short":"Aug 11","content_date":"2026-08-11T11:00:02-07:00","publish_date_diff":"57 days Hulu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e).\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe second trailer for the series has arrived, which hints at a new dangerous mission about to unfold. The next chapter in a story that began with the fan-favorite \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions/episode-guide-the-ninth-jedi\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“The Ninth Jedi”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e short from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eVolume 1, and continued with  \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions/the-ninth-jedi-child-of-hope-episode-guide\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“The Ninth Jedi - Child of Hope”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eVolume 3, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Presents - The Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e will \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003efollow Kara’s newest adventure in a galaxy far, far away.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDoes the Force actually guide you?\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSearch your feelings for the answer and watch the new trailer in English below. (See the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kts0nrr8L_I\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003efull Japanes\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ee trailer\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e here\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/Hsc2ZAn9vLA\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe 8-episode limited anime series is part of an all-new \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions Presents \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ebanner, which allows filmmakers to tell longer-form \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e stories. Picking up not long after the events of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eVisions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e shorts, in the new series, Lah Kara continues to train in the ways of the Jedi under Margrave Juro amid an epic journey of self-discovery as she and Juro’s small fellowship of Jedi-in-training embark on a quest to save her father.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEarlier this summer, Lucasfilm and Production I.G. unveiled the first trailer and teaser poster for the series, revealed at Anime Expose 2026. Watch \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://youtu.be/6nUStmkGRec\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe original Japanes\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ee trailer h\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eere\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e or the full English dub anime trailer below. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/r70AWJ-zJS4\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is directed by Shunsuke Tada and written by Mitsuyasu Sakai. Kenji Kamiyama serves as supervising director. Executive producers are James Waugh, Jacqui Lopez, Josh Rimes, Justin Leach, and Mitsuhisa Ishikawa; the producers are Hitoshi Ito and Kanako Shirasaki, and the co-producer is Caroline Keller.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe English dub voice talent includes returning voice cast Kimiko Glenn (Lah Kara), Andrew Kishino (Juro), Masi Oka (Ethan), Patrick Seitz (Homen), JP Karliak (Gramps), and Simu Liu (Lah Zhima). Neil Kaplan returns to voice The Narrator. The new English voice talent includes Feodor Chin (Gennoh), Young Mazino (Nawaam), Chase Sui Wonders (Tafflah), and Keone Young (Kwana).\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe returning original language voice talent includes Chinatsu Akasaki (Lah Kara), Tetsuo Kanao (Juro), Hiromu Mineta (Ethan), Hinata Tadokoro (Homen), Cho (Gramps), and Shinichiro Miki (Lah Zhima). Akio Otsuka returns to voice The Narrator.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJoin Kara on her journey in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e: A \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eNew H\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eope\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eis getting a new Welsh language dub, introducing fans to a new version of the 1977 classic film. The news was announced today at the National Eisteddfod, and Lucasfilm and Disney are producing the dub in collaboration with S4C and the Welsh Government via Creative Wales. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe official title of the new project is \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Gobaith Newydd, \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ewhich will broadcast on S4C and across its platforms later this year, beginning Christmas Day 2026. The broadcast will come just in time for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eA New Hope \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eto celebrate its \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-50th-anniversary-theatrical-release\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003e50\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eth annivers\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eary\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in 2027.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/han-solo\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHa\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003en Solo\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Rhys Ifans as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/obi-wan-kenobi\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKeno\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ebi\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and Aimee-Ffion Edwards as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/leia-organa\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePrin\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ece\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ess \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eL\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eeia\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e veteran Mark Lewis Jones — who previously played Captain Canady in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-viii-the-last-jedi\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Last Jedi \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e— takes on the role of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eD\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003earth\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, while rising talent Osian Morgan voices \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/luke-skywalker\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLu\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ek\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ee Sk\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eywa\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003elker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The wider Welsh cast includes Llyr Ifans (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/c-3po\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eC-3\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePO\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e)\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Nia Roberts (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/beru-lars\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAu\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ent Be\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eru\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e), Richard Harrington (\u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grand-moff-tarkin\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrand\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Moff\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e T\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003earkin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e), Owain Arthur (Red Leader), and Rhodri Meilir (Gold Leader). \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEllyn Stern directs the Welsh language dub, which is produced by Lucasfilm Director of Distribution Operations Michael Kohn. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“We're really excited about this project for many reasons,” Kohn explains. “I've been involved in a few Indigenous dubs of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eover the years that aim to preserve and revitalize interest in learning the language. They have been tremendously successful not only in their communities but internationally as well. The chance to celebrate the Welsh language through \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is one we couldn’t pass up.” \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe dub is especially meaningful for Lucasfilm Co-President \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.lucasfilm.com/leadership/lynwen-brennan/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLynwen Brennan\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, who was born and raised in Wales and can’t wait to share this unique new version with fans. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“Wales has such a rich history of storytelling and a beautiful lyrical language,” she says. “We have never before had a translation of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e into Welsh, and I am so thankful that in celebration of our 50th anniversary, we have been able to work with some incredible Welsh talent to make that a reality. Welsh speakers will finally be able to enjoy the film in our native language, and my hope is that it will have the same emotional impact as if you were watching the film again for the first time.\"   \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLucasfilm and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ehave a long history with Wales, going back to 1979, when a full-size \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/millennium-falcon\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eMillennium Falcon\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ewas built at Pembroke Dock for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-v-the-empire-strikes-back\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar away.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eS\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003etar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Presents - The Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, a new limited series from Lucasfilm and Production I.G, arrives in one week on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi-trailer\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDisney+ and Hulu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e! The story, which began in the fan-favorite “The Ninth Jedi” short from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Volume 1 and continued with the poignant “The Ninth Jedi - Child of Hope” in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Volume 3, takes place in a future long after the fall of the Sith. The \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jedi-order\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jedi Order\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJedi Order\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is gone, but hope remains for their return to a galaxy torn apart by war.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBefore Kara’s journey resumes in the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-921588f0-9a3b-4cd6-80d6-0a7cc9ed388a?cid=DTCI-Synergy-StarWars-Site-Acquisition-StarWars-US-DisneyPlus-NA-EN-BlogArticleEmbed-Generic-NA\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003enew series arriving August 5\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, let’s take a moment to get reacquainted with her and some of the people she encounters during her galaxy-spanning adventure so far.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-lah-kara_b0fda0ac.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,532\" alt=\"Lah Kara\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLah Kara\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLah Kara is a spirited teenage girl who lives with her father, a sabersmith, on the frozen world of Hy Izlan. Kara has a natural talent for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lightsaber\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"lightsaber\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003elightsaber\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e combat and begins training in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-force\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the Force\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Force\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e when she’s very young, although she struggles with believing in her own abilities. Years later, when her father is captured by Jedi Hunters, Kara seeks out Margrave Juro for help and finds herself in the middle of a \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/sith\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Sith\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSith\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e ambush.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile Kara initially wields a colorless lightsaber blade, it turns bright green in her hands as she holds her own against the Sith warriors in the Aerial Temple. As Kara \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/anime-expo-the-ninth-jedi-filmmaker-interview\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003econtinues her mission to find and rescue her father\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, her strength and trust in the Force grows.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-lah-zhima_cb998971.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,536\" alt=\"Lah Zhima\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eLah Zhima\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOnce a Jedi Knight renowned for his combat ability, Lah Zhima makes a new home on the remote planet of Hy Izlan with his daughter, Kara. As a sabersmith, Zhima has the aptitude and knowledge to temper kyber crystals to reflect the wielder’s connection to the Force. After he builds eight lightsabers at Margrave Juro’s request, Zhima is seized by Jedi Hunters and transported to Nawaam’s vast fortress.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-ethan_26e1d885.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Ethan\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEthan\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAn earnest young man, Ethan is one of the seven Force users who responded to Margrave Juro’s summons to the Aerial Temple of Hy Izlan. He has no Master but feels a strong connection to the Force. Ethan’s lightsaber blade is blue, and he wields it without fear when the Sith reveal themselves. Afterward, he accompanies Juro, Homen, and Kara as they search for a way to save Lah Zhima and rebuild the Jedi Order.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-margrave-juro_f58c1620.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Margrave Juro\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eMargrave Juro\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eMargrave Juro is the leader of the remote Outer Rim planet Hy Izlan. Once a Jedi Knight who trained alongside Lah Zhima under Master Reno Tsutara, he now seeks to restore the Jedi Order. Juro bears a long scar across his face that hints at a history of hard-fought battles. A lightsaber blade glows green when held in Juro’s hands.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-99-99_70dca9ad.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,538\" alt=\"99-99 (Four-Nines)\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e99-99 (Four-Nines)\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFour-Nines is a small, floating droid with yellow plating who stays resolutely by Lah Kara’s side, even when she ventures into danger. She considers the excitable droid a friend and turns to him for a hug when she needs comfort. Later, Four-Nines accompanies Ethan on a perilous but important undercover mission.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-gramps_464e30e8.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Gramps (Old Droid)\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eGramps (Old Droid)\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDespite his advanced age and cantankerous personality, Gramps is a skillful and wily pilot droid that agrees to Kara’s request to take her to the station orbiting Hy Izlan. (He’d rather be relaxing with a hot drink, though.) Gramps later accompanies Kara, Juro, Homen, and Ethan on their mission to rescue Lah Zhima.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-homen_54c6736a.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Homen\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eHomen\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTowering and imposing, the fur-covered Homen wields a red lightsaber with the other Sith when Kara first meets him. In truth, he’s a Jedi who was unduly influenced by the others’ darkness. Homen breaks free of their sway, and his lightsaber blade cools to a light purple color. The levelheaded Force wielder joins the quest to revive the Jedi Order.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-roden_9df6f76d.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,538\" alt=\"Roden\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRoden\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOne of the seven who answers Margrave Juro’s call to Hy Izlan, Roden is poised and decisive, the epitome of a Jedi. But the red glow of a lightsaber in his hand reflects his concealed Sith temperament. Roden wields crimson \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/force-lightning\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Force Lightning\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eForce lightning\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and unleashes it against Juro, but the experienced Jedi resists his attack. Roden meets a fiery end soon after.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-hanbei_ccaceb0e.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,544\" alt=\"Hanbei\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eHanbei\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHanbei is short in stature with blue skin and oversized ears. The elder Jedi responds to Margrave Juro’s call to join him at the Aerial Temple orbiting Hy Izlan. When Hanbei ignites his lightsaber, the red blade reveals his true nature as an acolyte of the Sith alongside Roden, Toguro, Niizo, and Hen Jin. He attacks Juro to put an end to his plans to reestablish the Order, but Hanbei is no match for the experienced fighter.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-jedi-hunters_6317f97d.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Jedi Hunters\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eJedi Hunters\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Jedi Hunters are a group of mercenaries relentless in their pursuit of capturing or eliminating potential Jedi. A h\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eunter\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e named Bee-Toh captured Lah Zhima on Nawaam’s orders.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-teto_0b4db564.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,538\" alt=\"Teto\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTeto\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhen Kara is set adrift in space, the selfless \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/service-droid\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"service droid\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eservice droid\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Teto rescues her and pulls her onto his derelict ship. He asks for her help to reach his Master, who has been trapped inside an inaccessible \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/bacta-tank\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"bacta tank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ebacta tank\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e since they fled a war on the planet Kaamui hundreds of years earlier. While they discover Teto’s Master passed away decades ago, Teto is grateful to Kara for the chance to see him again. The kindhearted droid sacrifices himself to safely return Kara to her friends.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-anda_6285ba49.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Anda\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAnda\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe merciless Jedi Hunter Anda pursues Kara and her friends across the galaxy. He tracks her to Teto’s disabled ship with his associate, Unda, to collect a bounty of 100 million credits offered by Nawaam. Anda is well-trained in the use of combat weapons, including a crackling \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/electrostaff\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Electrostaff\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eElectrostaff\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e capable of parrying a lightsaber blade.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-general-nawaam_a0daa376.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,534\" alt=\"General Nawaam\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eGeneral Nawaam\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGeneral Nawaam is a helmeted figure fully clad in black. He’s amassing a fleet to bring his idea of order to the chaos of the galaxy, which includes the extermination of the Jedi. The brutish fighters he gathers for his army serve him loyally in support of his cause. Shockingly, Nawaam’s lightsaber burns the bright blue of a Jedi’s blade — not the red of a Sith.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-gennoh_81cd2cf8.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Gennoh\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eGennoh\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA Sith who pursues the Jedi on Nawaam’s orders, Gennoh’s face is almost completely obscured by a metal mask. The arrogant warrior, formidable in the Force, is utterly confident in his dark side abilities. He commands a colossal ship that dwarfs any vessels that oppose him.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-ninth-jedi-character-guide-dunbai_532db991.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,540\" alt=\"Dunbai\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDunbai\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe leader of Makoma Ko, Dunbai is a former Jedi Knight who left behind his Force training and chose to protect his people through politics and commerce instead. He once operated as a merchant in the Outer Rim before assuming leadership of the free city-state.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe 8-episode floor.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eStop by the Lucasfilm Pavilion to see the Anzellan starship from the feature film, including all four Anzellan droidsmiths responsible for the upkeep on the tiny transport. A marvel of miniaturized technology, the Anzellan starship is just large enough to fit its tiny crew as they travel the galaxy.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv mh-tiktok-node-alignment=\"center\" mh-tiktok-node-src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7665841833582284062\" class=\"mh-tiktok\" style=\"justify-content: center; display: flex;\"\u003e\n\u003cblockquote class=\"tiktok-embed\" data-video-id=\"7665841833582284062\" data-embed-from=\"oembed\" cite=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7665841833582284062\" style=\"margin: 0px; padding: 0px; max-width: 325px;\"\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.tiktok.com/@starwars/video/7665841833582284062\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/blockquote\u003e\n\u003cscript src=\"https://www.tiktok.com/embed.js\" id=\"mh-social-widget-script\" async=\"\"\u003e\u003c/script\u003e\n\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIf you would like to see the baby, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-mandalorian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Din Djarin\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDin Djarin\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrogu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e take center stage, with the Mandalorian’s screen-used armor on display along with his partner in bounty hunting for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-new-republic\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the New Republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe New Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, little Grogu. Don’t let his size fool you — he’s small but mighty.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnd rounding out the pint-sized stars, the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rotta-the-huttlet\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Rotta the Hutt\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRotta the Hutt\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e maquette is on display along with a gallery of concept art showcasing the design and illustration that brought Favreau’s vision for the film to life.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIf you don’t consider yourself a friend of the gang (but you do
