for.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNext year, we embark on a journey celebrating the legacy of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand the power of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-force\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the Force\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Force\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and fandom when the largest and most comprehensive behind-the-scenes traveling exhibition to date opens in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, ahead of a five-year tour of North America. But today, we took our first steps into that larger world with our first look at exhibit renderings, official key art and other new details during the official panel at San Diego Comic-Con.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/swe_keyart_original_8a6023d4.jpeg?region=0,0,1266,1080\" alt=\"Star Wars: The Experience – A Journey Through the Galaxy key art\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://fi.edu/en/exhibits-and-experiences/star-wars-experience?utm_source=starwars.com\u0026amp;utm_medium=editorial\u0026amp;utm_campaign=swte_2026\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe E\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003experience – \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA Journey Through the Galaxy\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, is a world premiere exhibition opening at The Franklin Institute on February 13, 2027, as part of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e50th anniversary celebration, \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003einviting fans of all ages inside the galaxy’s creation and celebrating the art, innovation, and fandom that have made \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e a global phenomenon.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTold through an extraordinary collection of more than 70 artifacts — many of them on view for the first time from Lucasfilm — the exhibit invites you to take a closer look at legendary screen-used pieces including \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-maul\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Darth Maul\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Maul\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lightsaber\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"lightsaber\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003elightsaber\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e hilt and Darth Vader’s menacing armor, as well as a selection of fan-favorite aliens, droids, and creatures, including the Mandalorian’s faithful companion Grogu (from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/Star-Wars-The-Mandalorian-and-Grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, on digital now), and the droid duo that started it all, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/r2-d2\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"R2-D2\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eR2-D2\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/c-3po\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"C-3PO\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eC-3PO\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. A celebration of the depth and breadth of storytelling in the galaxy far, far away, the exhibition also includes vehicles like a full-sized \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/speeder-bike\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"speeder bike\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003espeeder bike\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and original props from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/andor\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Andor\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAndor\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the critically-acclaimed and Emmy and Peabody Award-winning Disney+ series.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCreated by The Franklin Institute, in collaboration with MDSX, Lucasfilm and Disney Consumer Products, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Experience \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eis an all-new exhibition spanning 18,000 square feet of visually rich, interconnected galleries, featuring large immersive moments, screen-used artifacts, and an RFID-powered experience for an interactive, personalized, and cinematic journey into the creative force behind \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFrom sound design and costume creation to fan art and gaming, the exhibition celebrates the intersection of art, innovation, and fandom, showcasing the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003elegacy as a mythology that has always been, and will always be, built by dreamers. Celebrating the groundbreaking evolution and innovations of both Lucasfilm and Industrial Light \u0026amp; Magic, it charts the path from analog ingenuity to digital reinvention and highlights the voices of early makers and the current global fandom, uncovering the creativity, craftsmanship, and community that make\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e Star Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e a timeless treasure beloved by people around the globe.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\"Lucasfilm has always been at the forefront of merging cutting edge technology and limitless storytelling,\" says Lynwen Brennan, Co-President of Lucasfilm. \"In collaboration with The Franklin Institute, we are creating an experience that reflects that very spirit of curiosity and creativity. As we mark the incredible milestone of the 50th anniversary of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, we wanted to develop something truly extraordinary — a space that honors both the visionary pioneers who built this galaxy, and the remarkable fan community at its heart. '\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e: The Experience' is a testament to five decades of innovative storytelling, and we are excited for visitors to immerse themselves in the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e legacy through this new exhibition.\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ecreated a cultural landscape that spans decades and delivers massive, undeniable global appeal,” adds Larry Dubinski, President and CEO of The Franklin Institute. “Its influence extends far beyond cinema—shaping entertainment, culture, technology, and business, while redefining how stories are created, experienced, and shared across generations. The Franklin Institute is excited to put Philadelphia once again at the center of a major cultural moment with another blockbuster world premiere exhibition in 2027.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEnter the Throne Room on Naboo\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eOfficial exhibition renderings and key art were unveiled today during the exclusive panel at San Diego Comic-Con, moderated by Ashley Eckstein,\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e actor and the voice of Ahsoka Tano in animated series including \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Clone Wars, \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-rebels\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e, \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/tales-of-the-jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eTales of the Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e — with panel experts including Matt Martin, Sr. Creative Executive of Franchise Content and Strategy at Lucasfilm; Portia Fontes, Manager of Physical Assets at Lucasfilm; Abby Bysshe, Chief Experience and Strategy Officer at The Franklin Institute; Dan Picard, Creative Officer and Owner of MDSX; and Dave Edmonds, Art Director at MDSX.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAmong the highlights discussed were:\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/sdcc-2026-star-wars-lucasfilm-publishing-panel-unabridg_c38e561a.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Original Trilogy Unabridged Audiobooks | Padme's throne room concept\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eQueen Amidala\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’\u003c/span\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003es Throne Room:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Walk the path of Naboo royalty in a room of suspended fabric and projection, surrounded by voices and imagery from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e makers. Along the way, you'll encounter key costumes and design stories that culminate with an audience at Queen Amidala’s throne and a closer look at her regal gown.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/sdcc-2026-star-wars-lucasfilm-publishing-panel-unabridg_cf8821b2.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Original Trilogy Unabridged Audiobooks | TIE fighter concept\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWireframe Worlds:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Anchored by a wireframe TIE Fighter, this gallery celebrates the blueprint stage of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e set design. Edge-lit acrylic panels and displayed artifacts \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eshowcase\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e early vehicle sketches and design notes that evolved into cinematic icons, while surrounding graphics display diagrams of the many ships that have brought the different sagas to life.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/sdcc-2026-star-wars-lucasfilm-publishing-panel-unabridg_a418fbac.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Original Trilogy Unabridged Audiobooks | Han in carbonite concept\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCarbon Freeze Capture:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003e In this dramatic, photo-ready moment, come face-to-face with a full-scale Han Solo in carbonite surrounded by two interactive stations. Make like an ugnaught and fire off your own “carbon freeze” sequence — an unforgettable fusion of storytelling and \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003etechnology \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethat allows you to step directly into one of cinema’s most iconic scenes. You'll love it. We know.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eThe Force that \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eConnects Us:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eUsing the latest RFID technology, your journey becomes uniquely personal, shaped by your choices and driven by your Force allegiance. Move throughout the exhibition, experience hidden moments, evolving interactions, and story elements that unfold all around you, culminating in one memorable\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003efinale.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e50 Years of \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar Wars:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe exhibition also includes an unprecedented look at 50 years of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e action figure history and creation, featuring more than 100 iconic \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e toys, including over 30 rare prototypes, development models, tooling samples, and original design materials, some of which have never been displayed publicly before. This unique showcase reveals how Kenner’s and Hasbro's artistry has evolved alongside the saga itself, from the first Original Trilogy figures to today's premium collectibles, while continuing to introduce \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003enew designs\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e inspired by the latest \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e stories.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://fi.edu/en/exhibits-and-experiences/star-wars-experience?utm_source=starwars.com\u0026amp;utm_medium=editorial\u0026amp;utm_campaign=swte_2026\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTickets will go on sale in November for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Experience\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, which will run from February 13 to September 6, 2027. \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003elig\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ehtsa\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eber\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, she knew she had to get her own version of the hilt. \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Twin Crossroads\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the new adult novel announced during the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel at San Diego Comic-Con.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSpeaking exclusively to StarWars.com on the news, the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eNew York Times \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ebestselling author says her new book follows immediately after the events of her novel, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Princess and the Scoundrel\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, delving into a moment glimpsed in flashback in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-rise-of-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Rise of Skywalker\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e that shows \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/luke-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Luke Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLuke Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e training his first student — his twin sister — on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ajan-kloss\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Ajan Kloss\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAjan Kloss\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. As\u003c/span\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLuke and Leia train as Jedi in this essential adventure set after the Rebel victory in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Return of the Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Return of the href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/coruscant\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Coruscant\" rel=\"noopener href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Anakin Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/padme-amidala\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Padmé Amidala\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ePadmé Amidala\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and ultimately, their diverging futures in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-force\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the Force\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Force\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“My favorite thing was coming up with where Leia got her \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lightsaber-crystal\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"kyber crystal\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ekyber crystal\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, which I cannot believe they let me do,” Revis teases. “I flipped out. This is the first time I've ever been able to talk about it!” The book, which is slated to debut in 2027 amid the 50th anniversary of the original \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e film, covers every era of galactic storytelling, Revis says, with nods to all three Skywalker Saga trilogies, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/andor\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Andor\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eAndor\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and the Marvel \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Battle of \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eJ\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eak\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eku\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e comics just to name a few.  Revis also studied \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-legacy\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Legacy \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eby Madeleine Roux\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, which arrives later this month, as essential reading. “Knowing how Leia approached her training with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rey\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Rey\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRey\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e helped me figure out how Luke approached it with Leia,” Revis says. “Having all of these stories interconnected and interwoven is my favorite thing about \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. They all weave together and they're all connected. Finding ways to make those connections stronger is my main goal when I'm writing a story. And just seeing that moment [in the movie] where she had the lightsaber in her hand …we know that Leia's the kind of person who does not do anything by halves. She was always going to give it her all in whatever she did. So naturally, that had me wondering: what changed? There is a whole lifetime summed up in that one moment when she rips off her helmet.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/luke-leia-training_5ca32b2a.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,847\" alt=\"Luke and Leia training together. \" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBrother and sister\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWe all have our favorite \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003echaracters, and Leia is definitely Revis’s.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“I love writing Leia for many, many reasons, especially because, you know, I grew up with her,” Revis says. “She was my princess and then my general. She was absolutely my favorite character. And she had a huge impact on my life because I had a brother named Luke.” In fact, the siblings had their own version of Jedi training. “I distinctly remember when we were growing up and my parents were remodeling a house, my brother and I would take PVC pipes and just bash each other with them and pretend they were lightsabers,” Revis says.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRevis tapped into her relationship with her brother as she was exploring the Skywalker twins’ story. “There are several moments where the mask comes off for both of them, because at this point, Luke is kind of austere. He's \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-viii-the-last-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"The Last Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe Last Jedi\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, but not when he's in front of his sister. In fact, in the very first chapter, they have a fight over who's going to wash the dishes.” Spoiler alert: It’s not going to be Leia.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-luke-training_fce0341e.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,536\" alt=\"Luke looks at Leia while they train.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“For me, the biggest thing that I wanted to do is make them sound human,” Revis continues. “I had to think of Luke as his own person. He's not the staunch warrior who knows everything or the wise monk on the mountain. He's just Luke who wanted to go to \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tosche-station\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Tosche Station\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTosche Station\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“And it wasn't like the general and the princess talking to the Jedi Master. It was brother and sister. So they're going to bicker a little bit. They're going to have inside jokes. Especially when they're on Ajan Kloss, in a place where there's no one else around,” Revis says. “There's no judgment. There's no need to be posturing. They can just be themselves. And for both of them, it's a rare moment. I tried to linger in that element and show this is who they are honestly with each other when there's no audience.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eUnlimited power\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image media-image-inline\" style=\"margin-left: 1rem; float: right; max-width: 40%;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-rebel-rising_7d3de8cd.jpeg?region=0,0,719,1080\" alt=\"Star Wars: Rebel Rising\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs the third \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e book Revis has penned, beginning with 2017’s \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Rebel Rising\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e featuring \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jyn-erso\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jyn Erso\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJyn Erso\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Revis says she’s discovered a lot of freedom in writing in the galaxy far, far away. “When I wrote \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eRebel Rising\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, I felt like I had to do all the research on all the planets and use ones that had already been established. Then there was a moment where [Lucasfilm] said, ‘You know, you can just make up your own planet. The galaxy is huge.’ And that just sort of blew my mind. I’m so grateful for the creative freedom that \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e has given me. They care about the story and they care about the creation of that story in such a personal way that I truly value. So I feel like I was able to take some big swings because I knew that they would at least hear me out.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn addition to adding lore to Leia’s lightsaber, Revis also incorporates another established artifact into the book: Luke Skywalker’s star compass, which first appeared in the video game \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Battlefront II \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand later the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eBattle of Jakku \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003ecomics.\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“Luke, at that time, is looking for Jedi artifacts,” Revis says, “and that led me to the idea that it’s because he has a Padawan now and he wants to make sure that he can train her well. Even though he's the last Jedi, he still feels inadequate and has a little imposter syndrome.” Luke did, after all, leave \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/dagobah\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Dagobah\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDagobah\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and cut his training with Jedi Master \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/yoda\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Yoda\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eYoda\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e short. “He gave up his full training in order to save his friends, which is a noble thing to do, but how is that going to impact what he can do in the future?” Revis asks.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe compass is also symbolic of Luke’s journey, as both twins must figure out their futures. “The compass isn't working and he doesn't know how to fix it,” Revis adds. “They're both at the crossroads of trying to determine how they're going to move on with their lives and what they're going to become.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRead the official synopsis below and get ready to train with Luke and Leia when \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Twin Crossroads \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eby Beth Revis arrives next year! And read even more publishing news with StarWars.com’s official coverage of San Diego Comic-Con.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStar Wars: Twin Crossroads\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBy Beth Revis\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image media-image-inline\" style=\"margin-left: 1rem; float: right; max-width: 40%;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-twin-crossroads-cover-nf_081c1ae2.jpeg?region=0,0,711,1080\" alt=\"Star Wars: Twin Crossroads By Beth Revis\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOn Sale Date: April 2027\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRandom House Worlds\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOfficial Book Description:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAfter the events of \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/star-wars-episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"bolds\" aria-label=\"Return of the Jedi\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eReturn of the Jedi\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cb\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e,\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003e Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa train together in the ways of the Jedi. The siblings must confront the legacies of their birth parents Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala, and their own diverging futures in the Force.\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe second \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/death-star\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Death Star\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDeath Star\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is in ruins. As the burgeoning New Republic pursues scattered Imperial forces across the galaxy, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa train on the remote planet of Ajan Kloss and walk the path of the Jedi side-by-side.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDuring this reprieve from battle, t\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eh\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ee t\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003ewins\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e grow their connection to the Force and their own bond as they shoulder the responsibility of carrying on the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jedi-order\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jedi Order\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJedi Order\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s legacy. But each also carries a burden they struggle to share with the other. Luke loves seeing his sister excel but doubts his teaching ability when there is still so much to discover and learn. Leia, meanwhile, is determined to master these new skills, but she struggles with both what it would mean to commit her life entirely to serving the Force and the knowledge of being \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Darth Vader\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e’s daughter.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDespite their doubts, Luke and Leia volunteer for an urgent covert New Republic mission to infiltrate the center of Imperial power: Coruscant.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTheir quest begins at the Imperial palace, once the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jedi-temple\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jedi Temple\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJedi Temple\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, where they gain a new understanding of the former Jedi Order and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/galactic-republic\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Galactic Republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGalactic Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The mission will be more transformative than either could imagine, as they discover the legacy left behind by their birth parents on a planet where some are still willing to hope. And though certainty is scarce, Luke and Leia’s faith in one another will help them each seek out the path they must ultimately walk.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"July 24, Kara, Nawaam, and what it means to be a Jedi or a Sith.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image media-image-inline\" src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/star-wars-theninthjedi-photobooth_4ebd0b91.jpeg?region=0,0,864,1080\" alt=\"(L to R) Supervising Director Kenji Kamiyama, Director Shunsuke Tada, and Producer Hitoshi Ito.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003cfigcaption style=\" text-align: center;\"\u003e(L to R) Supervising Director Kenji Kamiyama, Director Shunsuke Tada, and Producer Hitoshi Ito.\u003c/figcaption\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLucasfilm and Production I.G’s\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“The Ninth Jedi,” the tale of young Lah Kara’s quest to rescue her father, debuted in the innovative first volume of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: Visions\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. The fan-favorite story continued in the third volume with the poignant and unforgettable \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions/the-ninth-jedi-child-of-hope-episode-guide\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“Child of Hope.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Now, \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, an all-new limited anime series, continues Kara’s story \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi-trailer\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAugust 5, exclusively on Disney+ and Hulu\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAhead of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi-trailer\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003erevealing a new official trailer at Anime Expo\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Producer Hitoshi Ito, Supervising Director Kenji Kamiyama, and Director Shunsuke Tada spoke to StarWars.com about creating the imaginative series, the foreboding new foe Nawaam, and what the future holds for Kara.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“I was very happy to hear that fans from all over the world especially liked \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e,” said Ito.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKamiyama wanted to tell the complete tale of Kara’s adventures since their first foray in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. “When I got offered to make a short at the very beginning, I worked on it as if I was working for a feature film,” he said. “I was already building a lot of character backgrounds and settings.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/r70AWJ-zJS4\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe series is set in the distant future, long after the Empire and the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rebel-alliance\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Rebel Alliance\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRebel Alliance\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, when the Jedi have faded into legend. Lah Kara, the daughter of Lah Zhima, leaves her home alongside new Jedi allies to free her father from the clutches of Jedi Hunters\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Kara’s father is the only known sabersmith in the galaxy, making the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lightsaber\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"lightsaber\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003elightsaber\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e – and Zhima himself – an invaluable asset.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/concept-art-star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi-l_10ef939a.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1268\" alt=\"Lightsaber hilt concept art by Mai Otani.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003cfigcaption style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003eLightsaber hilt concept art by Mai Otani.\u003c/figcaption\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eIn \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the color of a lightsaber blade changes according to the wielder’s alignment with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-force\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the Force\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Force\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e – a concept that stemmed from a delightful misconception. When Kamiyama watched the original \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e trilogy for the first time, he assumed that lightsabers automatically changed color; while he later became aware of his mistake, he brought that compelling idea into his vision of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/stills-gallery-star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jed_93177bd0.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,804\" alt=\"A trailer strill from Star Wars: Visions Presents — The Ninth Jedi.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZhima raised his daughter Kara to respect and use the Force, but with some reservations. “He didn’t want his daughter Kara to be a Jedi,” said Ito, “because his understanding was that Jedi dispense justice. To succeed in that mission, they might sometimes need to kill someone. For Zhima, that was a challenge. But Kara is a new generation of Jedi, so overcoming that challenge and developing herself is a big theme in the latter part of the series.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHer earnest personality and humble origins are reminiscent of another young hero setting off on an unexpected adventure that takes him far from home: \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/luke-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Luke Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLuke Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“Luke was also an unknown boy and not talented in the beginning, [and] he gradually becomes a true Jedi,” said Tada. “We tried not to make Kara look like a Master from the beginning, but she’s gradually growing. In the original story of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Kara’s not trying to win over her father or somebody else. She’s trying to win over herself and grow as a person.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBut Kara is a more modern hero, Kamiyama added.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/stills-gallery-star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jed_14128269.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,798\" alt=\"A trailer strill from Star Wars: Visions Presents — The Ninth Jedi.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/concept-art-star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jedi-k_d3dfa1a6.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1261\" alt=\"Kara concept art by Tetsuya Nishio.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003cfigcaption style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003eKara concept art by Tetsuya Nishio.\u003c/figcaption\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“I feel like she's a very modern character,” he said. “She already has a kind of natural talent in her. She doesn't know at the beginning, but she's naturally trained by Jedi. When she was chased by Jedi Hunters, the Jedi Hunters also saw something [in her] even though she didn't know. And [her connection with] the Force is becoming stronger, although she doesn't know how to use it.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/stills-gallery-star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jed_bba47a62.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,808\" alt=\"A trailer strill from Star Wars: Visions Presents — The Ninth Jedi.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eA hero always faces off against a villain, and in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, the masked General Nawaam – loosely inspired by \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/anakin-skywalker\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Anakin Skywalker\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAnakin Skywalker\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/darth-vader\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Darth Vader\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDarth Vader\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e – pursues his own idea of justice.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“A main [theme] of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e is that things aren’t always black and white, dark and light,” Kamiyama said. “I asked myself if there are some problems that Jedi cannot solve. There’s a contradiction that Jedi want to make peace, but there are some things they can’t solve with the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/jedi-order\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Jedi Order\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eJedi Order\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e only. Everyone has to have some kind dark side to solve something, to be good. But do you call it a completely dark side? We wanted to create a new definition of a Jedi. Kara is pure light side, but Nawaam reflects the duality of humans.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/stills-gallery-star-wars-visions-presents-the-ninth-jed_27bbf0de.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,805\" alt=\"A trailer strill from Star Wars: Visions Presents — The Ninth Jedi.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eKamiyama, Ito, and Tada enjoyed the process of exploring those themes and developing the characters of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e alongside their collaborators at Lucasfilm. “There was a lot of creative freedom, and we have a mutual respect,” Kamiyama said. “It was a very, very fun experience.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“This time, we developed together during script writing and setting,” Tada added. “That's why I felt really, ‘Oh my gosh, I'm on a \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e team.' I really felt that I'm part of the team.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eFollow Kara on her journey when \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e premieres August 5, 2026, on Disney+ and Hulu.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"},"publish_date":"July 3, 2026","publish_date_short":"Jul 3","content_date":"2026-07-02T18:55:00-07:00","publish_date_diff":"97 days is Zeb?\u003c/span\u003e","headline":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWho is Zeb?\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","summary_stripped":"\u003cspan\u003eDon’t let his crankiness fool you. This ‘Karabast’-spouting alien is one of many \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003erebels with a heart of gold.\u003c/span\u003e","summary":"\u003ch2\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDon’t let his crankiness fool you. This ‘Karabast’-spouting alien is one of many \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003erebels with a heart of gold.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e","main_content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lasat\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Lasat\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLasat\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e warrior Garazeb Orrelios, better known as \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/zeb-orrelios\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZeb\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, made his big-screen debut in the film \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/films/Star-Wars-The-Mandalorian-and-Grogu\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e after being introduced in the series \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/series/star-wars-rebels\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Star Wars Rebels\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand leaping to live action with a notable cameo in\u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003e The Mandalorian \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSeason 3. But who is Zeb? Let’s investigate Zeb’s history and where you can learn more about his backstory.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBehind the scenes\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDebuting in the 2014 animated series \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels,\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e Zeb was created to be a key part of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew, the Spectre rebel cell who later joined a unified \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/rebel-alliance\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Rebel Alliance\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eRebel Alliance\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Gruff, tough, and soft on the inside, Zeb was the muscle for his found family.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/who-is-zeb-concept-art_6de27b7c.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,948\" alt=\"Concept art of Zeb by Kilian Plunkett.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003cfigcaption style=\" text-align: center;\"\u003eConcept art of Zeb by Kilian Plunkett.\u003c/figcaption\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe origin of Zeb and his species, the Lasat, takes us back to the very beginnings of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003eand the earliest concept designs for Wookiees. \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eR\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eeb\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e art director Kilian Plunkett noted that Zeb was one of the trickiest of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew to design: “For a long time he was a blue Snivvian. Our final Zeb is a cross between Ralph McQuarrie’s original concept for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/chewbacca\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Chewbacca\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChewbacca\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and Dave Filoni’s cat.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile finding Zeb’s voice in the recording studio, actor Steve Blum originally tried out a variety of dialects for Zeb, finally settling on a South London accent with a little Australian sprinkled in. “I was so excited to get to work on a \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e cartoon,” remembers Blum, who revisits the character in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. “To get to co-create Zeb with this amazing team was beyond a fanboy’s wildest dreams.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEarly rebel years\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs part of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew, Zeb joined ace pilot \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/hera-syndulla\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Hera Syndulla\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHera Syndulla\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, Jedi Kanan Jarrus, Mandalorian \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/sabine-wren\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Sabine Wren\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eSabine Wren\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, and their droid \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/chopper\" target=\"_self\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChopper\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e in their fight against the Empire.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWorking on their own, the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew helped slow down Imperial actions and aid civilians who were impacted by Imperial tyranny. In fact, that’s how they met a young \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/lothal\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Lothal\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLothal\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e orphan named \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ezra-bridger\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Ezra Bridger\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eEzra Bridger\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, who joined their crew after they both tried to steal some Imperial cargo.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/who-is-zeb-droids-in-distress_0130b296.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt='Zeb in “Droid in Distress\"' title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZeb’s past is hinted at early in the series. In \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e“D\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003eroid in Distress,”\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan\u003e we find Zeb visibly upset when his team plans to sell \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/t-7-ion-disruptor-rifles\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"T-7 Ion Disruptor Rifles\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eT-7 ion disruptor rifles\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e to a local crime lord. Hera later tells Ezra that these weapons were used by the Empire to kill the Lasat population during the Siege of Lasan, explaining why Zeb feels so strongly that the weapons shouldn’t be used by anyone.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZeb’s strength is immediately apparent; he could do a lot of physical damage to an opponent before turning to his weapon, a specialized bo-rifle. Always ready to jump into action as the crew's muscle — especially if it involved knocking down \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/stormtroopers\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"stormtroopers\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003estormtroopers\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e — Zeb proved to be both fearless and in possession of a big heart. After selling cargo stolen from Imperials on Lothal, Zeb helped distribute food to a nearby village, a refuge for denizens who had lost their homes to Imperial greed.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhile Zeb had a kind smile for many, he was slow to trust Ezra as the newest \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew member. The duo’s relationship early on resembled that of warring siblings, but Zeb and Ezra grew closer over time, teaming up to steal a \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/tie-fighter\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"TIE fighter\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eTIE fighter\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and take on Inquisitors.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/who-is-zeb-chava_1c69f171.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Chava the Wise and the Ghost Crew.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eConnecting with his ancestors\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZeb was overwhelmed and shocked when he crossed paths with two Lasat refugees, as he believed he was the last of his species to survive the Siege of Lasan. The duo identified Zeb as a Captain of the Lasan High Honor Guard – a title he had not shared with any of his crewmates.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAfter learning that the Lasat refugees were trying to find Lira San, a planet thought to be the lost homeworld of his people, Zeb was at first skeptical the planet existed beyond mythical stories. But during a ritual where \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/chava\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Chava\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eChava\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e the Wise called upon Ashla, the Lasat name for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-force\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the Force\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe Force\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, for help to find Lira San, Zeb used his bo-rifle as the ancient Lasats once used theirs to help guide them to Wild Space to find the planet.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThere, Zeb learned that many of his kind were living in peace, safe from Imperials or other invaders. While Zeb chose to remain with the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew, he was able to shed some of his guilt from not being able to stop the Empire from destroying his home.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eZeb’s place in the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew's found family meant a lot to Blum. “It seemed to me that Zeb was one of these people who was just looking for purpose in his life,”says Blum. “It came from a lot of damage and grief and he was able to work through some of that in the process of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars Rebels\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e with this chosen family.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/kallus-bio-5_253edfa6.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,720\" alt=\"Agent Kallus and Zeb duel.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eFriends with the enemy\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eDuring his years as a member of the Spectre rebel cell, Zeb repeatedly came face to face with Imperial security officer \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/alexsandr-kallus\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Alexsandr Kallus\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAlexsandr Kallus\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Their rivalry and later friendship gave fans a unique perspective on the conflict between rebels and Imperial forces.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/who-is-zeb-geonosian-moon_e223be53.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Agent Kallus and Zeb are stranded together on a Geonosian moon.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eWhen they first met, Zeb took an instant dislike to Kallus, who had been stationed on Lothal to stamp out rebel activity. He discovered Kallus possessed a weapon that once belonged to a Lasat guardsman, which he obtained during the Siege of Lasan.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eHowever, when the two were stranded together on a \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/geonosian\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Geonosian\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGeonosian\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e moon, they exchanged stories as they tried to survive the night in an icy cave. During their time on the moon, both Zeb and Kallus could have easily betrayed the other, but they learned they had a few things in common.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/who-is-zeb-lothal_02e43c44.jpeg?region=0,0,1920,1080\" alt=\"Zeb was able to help lead the successful liberation of Lothal from Imperial occupation.\" title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eThe two parted with a greater understanding of each other that only deepened when Kallus turned against the Empire and began spying for the Rebellion. Zeb was quick to welcome Kallus when he subsequently joined the Rebellion at their base on Yavin. And after the war, Zeb took Kallus to Lira San, where he was welcomed as a friend.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBlum hopes a future \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eStar Wars\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e story might take Zeb back to Lira San to see what Zeb’s life is like there, perhaps with Kallus tending to their meiloorun farm. “For him to actually be able to experience that planet and how life has gone on and evolved for the Lasat species, I think, would be an amazing thing.”\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eA rebel hero\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"media-image\" style=\"text-align: center; max-width: 100%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;\"\u003e\u003cfigure\u003e\u003cimg src=\"https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/images/zeb-main-tms3_b370aa93.jpeg?region=0,0,1280,720\" alt=' Garazeb \"Zeb\" Orrelios' title=\"\"\u003e\u003c/figure\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAs the fight against the Empire continued, Zeb and the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e crew joined up with other rebel cells in Chopper Base on the planet \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/atollon\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Atollon\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAtollon\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. Zeb, along with Chopper and \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/ap-5\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"AP-5\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAP-5\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e, reprogrammed an Imperial recon droid to hide the base’s location from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/grand-admiral-thrawn\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Grand Admiral Thrawn\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eGrand Admiral Thrawn\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. But after an attack on the base, the rebels relocated to new headquarters on Yavin.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eLothal remained close to Zeb and his crew’s hearts as the Rebellion continued to grow. Despite suffering a personal loss along with his \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eGhost\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003e family, Zeb was able to help lead the successful liberation of the planet from Imperial occupation.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch2\u003e\u003cb class=\"bolds\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eContinuing the fight\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/b\u003e\u003c/h2\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"mh-youtube mh-youtube-responsive\"\u003e\u003ciframe src=\"https://www.youtube.com/embed/WEAZDT4_C_g\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\" allowfullscreen=\"true\"\u003e\u003c/iframe\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAfter fighting in the Battle of \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/scarif\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Scarif\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eScarif\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e and continuing to work with Hera throughout the Galactic Civil War, Zeb became a pilot for \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/the-new-republic\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"the New Republic\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003ethe New Republic\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e. He was with X-wing pilot \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/carson-teva\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Carson Teva\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCarson Teva\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e on \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/Adelphi-Base\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Adelphi Base\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAdelphi Base\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e when Teva received a call for assistance from \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://www.starwars.com/databank/nevarro\" tabindex=\"0\" class=\"a-rich-article\" aria-label=\"Nevarro\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\u003e\u003cspan\u003eNevarro\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eAt the outpost, Zeb trained new recruits for the New Republic fleet, helping form the next generation of freedom fighters.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eBlum notes that Zeb’s role in \u003c/span\u003e\u003ci\u003e\u003cem\u003eThe Mandalorian and Grogu \u003c/em\u003e\u003c/i\u003e\u003cspan\u003efurthers Zeb’s search for purpose as part of a team that is working to combat forces of evil in the galaxy. Sharing how much he enjoyed Zeb being a Chewbacca-like character in the film — a supportive warrior, friend, and co-pilot to Din Djarin’s rogue hero — Blum says Director Jon Favreau created a collaborative environment during production allowing Blum to improvise his lines and try new things. “Just as a fan, to see Zeb up there and in that capacity made all the hairs on my arms and back stand up simultaneously,” Blum says.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan\u003eCatch up with Zeb as he teams up with \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca
